sa: तेऽशक्नुवन्तः संप्राप्तुं वालिनं राक्षसोत्तमाः। तस्य बारूरुवेगेन परिश्रान्ता व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: The Rākşasas could not catch Vāli but were rather exhausted by the stroke of his arms and thighs.

sa: तदागन्तव्यमनिशं भवद्भिरिह संगतैः। अगस्त्याद्यास्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषयः संशितव्रताः॥ एवमस्त्विति तं प्रोच्य प्रयातुमुषचक्रमुः। एवमुक्त्वा गताः सर्वे ऋषयस्ते यथागतम्॥
en: You should always come here. Hearing this the Rșis like Agastya, who performed great penances said so be it and began to make a more. Having said so all the Rșis departed to their respective places.

sa: नेमौ शक्यौ रणे जेतुं सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः। तादृशं दर्शनं दृष्ट्वा मया चोदीरितं तव॥
en: These even the celestials and Asuras with Indra (at their head) are incompetent to quell. Seeing such sight, I speak to you as to their being alive.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः सीता सुरसुतोपमा। कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेमामेवमस्त्विति मैथिली॥
en: Hearing her words, Mithila's daughter-Sītāresembling the daughter of a celestial, with hands joined, said, "May this be so!

sa: एवमुक्ते तदा राम ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा। दशग्रीव उवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिरथाग्रतः॥
en: Thus addressed by the creator, Brahma, the Ten-necked one, O Rāma, standing before him with joined hands, said.

sa: नाजानाज्जीवती रामः स मां भरतपूर्वजः। जानन्तौ तु न कुर्यात्तां नो। हि परिमार्गणम्॥
en: Rāma, the elder brother of Bharata, dose not know that I am still alive or else he and Lakşmaņa would have ransacked the whole world for me.

sa: अङ्गदं तु पुरस्कृत्य ससैन्यं सपरिच्छदम्। सागरं तर सुग्रीव नीलेन च नलेन च॥
en: O Sugriva, placing Angada to the fore, do you, taking your host as well as the equipage, in company with Nila and Nala, cross over the Ocean.

sa: न च सीतां दशग्रीवः प्राप्नोति जनकात्मजाम्। बद्धं बलवता वैरमक्षयं राघवेण च ॥
en: But he could not spread his influence upon Sitā the daughter of king Jannak and deep rooted and eternal became the enmity with the highly powerful Rāghava.

sa: अमित्राणां भयकरो मित्राणामभयंकरः। अजेयो भविता पुत्रस्तव मारुत मारुतिः॥
en: Your son Hanuman, O Marut, will terrorise the foes and safeguard the friends. He will be in conquerable.

sa: स तं द्विपमथारुह्य विरूपाक्षो महाबलः। ननद भीमनिर्हादं वानरानभ्यधावत॥
en: And mounted on the elephant that highly powerful Virūpākṣa sent forth leonine roars and dashed against the monkeys.

sa: सोऽपि गन्धवहः पुत्रं प्रगृह्य गृहमानयत्। अञ्जनायास्तमाख्याय वरदत्तं विनिर्गतः॥
en: The Vāyu also brought his son at his house. He went out having told Añjanā about it all.

sa: ततस्त्वद्भुतसंकाशाः स्थिताः पर्वतमूर्धनि ॥ सीतां गृहीत्वा गच्छन्तं वानराः पर्वतोपमाः। ददृशुर्विस्मिताकारा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: Thereupon some monkeys resembling mountains, stationed on the summit of a mountain, stricken with wondrous fear and astonishment, beheld Ravana, the lord of Rākşasas proceed with Sītā.

sa: सिद्धिः प्राप्ता महाबाहो लोकाश्चाप्यक्षयास्तव॥ न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्यः शृणु चेदं वचो मम।
en: You have acquired success O mighty-armed one, and have attained to eternal happy regions. You should not give way to anger. Listen to these words of mine.

sa: इत्युदीरितवाक्ये तु देवे तस्मिन्महात्मनि। देवदुन्दुभ्यो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता॥
en: When that high-souled god had spoken thus celestial kettle-drums sounded and a blossomy shower rained from the sky.

sa: प्रवेश्य चैनं त्वरितो रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। यदागमनकृत्यं ते भूयस्तद्ब्रह्यशेषतः॥
en: And bringing Sumantra in, Ráma with eagerness said "Tell me fully the reason of this your fresh visit."

sa: यस्मिंश्च कारणे वायुश्चक्रोध च रुरोध च॥ प्रजाः शृणुध्वं तत्सर्वं श्रोतव्यं चात्मनः क्षमम्।
en: Hear, O created beings, why the wind, being enraged, has obstructed the course of all beings. All that deserves to be listened and it is right too.

sa: तं कुद्धो भगवानन्दी शंकरस्यापरा तनुः। अब्रवीत्तत्र तद्रक्षो दशाननमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Thereat, growing enraged, the reverend Nandi Sankara's other body spoke into that Rākṣasa The Ten-necked one present there.

sa: राक्षसेष्वथ यक्षेषु नरेषु कुत एव तु। भूतोऽथवा भविष्यो वा रथः कश्चिन्मया श्रुतः॥
en: Nor even among Rakshasas and Yakshas, how can there then be any among men? Nor have I heard of any that has been or that will be.

sa: तद्रावणबलं प्राप्य बलं तस्य महीपतेः॥ प्राणश्यत तदा सर्व हव्यं हुतमिवानले। युद्ध्वा च सुचिरं कालं कृत्वा विक्रममुत्तमम्॥ प्रज्वलन्तं तमासाद्य क्षिप्रमेवावशेषितम्। प्राविशत्संकुलं तत्र शलभा इव पावकम्॥
en: That host, of the king encountering the forces of Rāvana, were extinguished like to clarified butter thrown into the (sacrificial) fire. And having fought valorously for a long time, the remnant of the royal forces, suddenly coming in contact with the flaming Räkşasas ranks, were destroyed like to swarms of locusts entering into fire.

sa: जनान् योऽभिभवत्यन्यान् कर्मणा हि स वै पुमान्। न त्वेव जाल्पी कापाली वृत्तिमेषितुमर्हसि॥
en: The man who suppress another or in deeds is a man indeed. It is not proper that you should adopt a life which is idle and wretched,

sa: सौतिरुवाच भृगोः सुदयिता भार्या पुलोमेत्यभिविश्रुता। तस्यां समभवद्गर्भो भृगुवीर्यसमुद्भवः॥
en: Sauti replied : Bhrigu had a very beloved wife, (named Puloma) who became quick with child by him.

sa: दृश्यते च महाज्वालः करोति च न मे रुजम्। शिशिरस्येव सम्पातो लाङ्गूलाग्रे प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: I see it of exceeding brightness yet it pain me not. (On the contrary), at the end of my tail it seem like a mass of ice.

sa: श्रुत्वा पुत्रस्य तु वचः परमर्षिरुवाच तम्। अधीष्व पुत्र मोक्षं वै धर्मांच विविधानपि॥
en: Hearing these words of his son, the great Rishi said to him,-Do you study, O son, the Religion' of Liberation and all the various duties of life.

sa: रथानन्ये नरश्रेष्ठं परिवः समन्ततः। आत्तशस्त्राश्च सुहृदो रक्षणार्थं महीपतेः॥
en: Mounted on other horses, elephants and chariots, other foremost of men, O Bharata, surrounded him on all sides.

sa: निर्याणश्रीश्च या चस्याद्भास्वरा च सुदुर्लभा॥ सा ननाश मुहूर्तेन समे च स्खलिता हयाः।
en: The auspiciousness that was bright and rare when the army set out, was clean gone in a moment, and the steeds began to stumble on even ground.

sa: संरब्धाः समरे राजन् निजघ्नुरितरेतरम्। निघ्नन्तः समरेऽन्योन्यं शूराः परिघबाहवः॥
en: They, enraged, O king, struck each other in the encounter. Although these mighty armed heroes struck each other,

sa: सात्यकि दशभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमसेनं त्रिभिः शरैः। सहदेव त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्॥
en: Piercing Satyaki with ten arrows and Bhima with three and Sahadeva with as many, he assailed Yudhishthira greatly.

sa: सर्प उवाच पात्रे दत्त्वा प्रियाण्युक्त्वा सत्यमुक्त्वा च भारत। अहिंसानिरतः स्वर्ग गच्छेदिति मतिर्मम॥
en: The Serpent said : In my opinion, O Bharata, by bestowal of alims on deserving objects, endearing words, truthfulness and unenviousness one can have access to heaven.

sa: व्यूढेनैव सुघोरेण पूर्वद्वारात्स निर्ययौ। गजयूथनिकाशेन बलेन महता वृतः॥
en: And he went out by the Eastern entrance, environed by this exceedingly dreadful array, resembling troops of elephants.

sa: एष धर्मः क्षत्रियाणां प्रजानां परिपालनम्। उत्पथोऽन्यो महाराज मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः॥
en: Such is the duty of Kshatriyas, viz., the ruling of subjects. Any other, O king, would be considered as a wrong path for them. Do not grieve.

sa: लोकस्तद् वेद यदहं पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया। राज्यं स्फीतं महाबाहो स्त्रियश्च त्यक्तवान् पुरा॥ श्रुतः।
en: All the world know, that to compass the pleasure of my father, O mighty armed one, I formerly relinquished a swelling kingdom and the company of woman.

sa: अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। ऊचतुः परमोदारं वाक्यं मधुरभाषिणौ॥
en: And having saluted that foremost of ascetics resembling flaming fire, your addressed him in gentle and honied accents.

sa: ततस्तु कुन्ती दुपदात्मजां तामुवाच काले वचनं वदान्या। त्वमग्रमादाय कुरुष्व भद्रे बलिं च विप्राय च देहि भिक्षाम्॥
en: Thereupon the kind Kunti thus spoke to the daughter of the Panchala king, "O amiable girl, first take a portion of this (food) and offer it to the gods and give it away to the Brahmanas.

sa: सायं च भीमस्तु रिपुप्रमाथी जिष्णुर्यमौ चापि महानुभावौ। भैक्षं चरित्वा तु युधिष्ठिराय निवेदयाञ्चकुरदीनसत्त्वाः॥
en: That grinder of foes, Bhima and Jishnu (Arjuna) and the high-souled twins returned in the evening from their begging tour; and they cheerfully offered everything to Yudhishthira.

sa: इक्ष्वाकुवंशे धर्मिष्ठे गते नाशमसंशयम्। भविष्यन्ति प्रजाः सर्वाः शोकसंतापपीडिताः॥
en: And on the virtuous Ikşvāku race being extinct, without doubt, all the subjects shall be overwhelmed with grief.

sa: अग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि भोक्ष्ये भुक्तवति त्वयि। इच्छामि परतः शैलान् पल्वलानि सरांसि च ॥
en: Always I shall precede you when walking, and shall take my repast after you have taken it willing am I to view mountains, rivulets, lakes and ponds.

sa: स्थातुमुत्सहते कश्चिन्न तस्मिन्नग्रतः स्थिते। न हि भूतं समं तेन त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते॥
en: Nobody can venture to withstand the fighter, in whose front walks Mahadeva himself. There is no creature in the triune worlds who is a match for him.

sa: लोभेनातिबलेन त्वं तृष्णया च वशीकृतः॥ कृतवानस्यकार्याणि विपाकस्तस्य भुज्यताम्।
en: Possessed by ungovernable covetousness and thirst of gain, you committed many unrighteous acts. Suffer now the consequences thereof.

sa: बभूव हि समा भूमिः समन्तात् पञ्चयोजनम्। शाद्वलैर्बहुभिश्छन्ना नीलवैदूर्यसंनिभैः॥
en: That spot widening into a level plain measuring five Yojanas was covered with thick grass resembling blue lapises.

sa: तत्परितोषाच्च श्रेयः सर्वज्ञतां चावाप। एषा तस्यापि परीक्षा वेदस्य॥
en: Veda obtained good fortune and universal knowledge as the result of his preceptor's satisfaction. This was his trial.

sa: अहं हि मनसा ध्याता सर्वान् नेष्यामि वः सदा। वृजिनात् तारयिष्यामि दुर्गेषु विषमेषु च॥ पृष्ठेन वो वहिष्यामि शीघ्रं गतिमभीप्सतः। यूयं प्रसादं कुरुत भीमसेनो भजेत माम्॥
en: Whenever you will think of me I will immediately come to you and carry you wherever you will command. I shall rescue you from danger over even and uneven grounds. I shall carry you on my back whenever you will desire to proceed with speed. Be gracious to me and make Bhimasena accept me.

sa: भ्रातुः स भवनं गत्वा रक्षोगणसमन्वितः। कुम्भकर्ण: पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम्॥
en: Kumbhakarņa surrounded by numbers of Rākşasas, entered his brother's abode, making the very earth tremble with his tread.

sa: यथा वायुर्जलधरान् विकर्षति ततस्ततः। तद्वज्जलदवत् सर्प कालस्याहं वशानुगः॥
en: As the clouds are driven hither and thither by the wind I, am, O serpent, moved by Kala.

sa: ततो रामो महातेजा आतं दृष्ट्वा हरीश्वरम्। स शरं वीक्षते वीरो वालिनो वधकाझ्या॥
en: And beholding that chief of monkeys greatly distressed, the highly powerful and heroic Rāma cast his looks upon his shaft, having the destruction of Väli in view.

sa: संजय उवाच यथाशक्तिं यथोत्साहं युद्धे चेष्टन्ति तावकाः। दर्शयानाः परं शक्त्या पौरुषं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Sanjaya said Your warriors strive in battle to the best of their strength and ardour, displaying, 0 foremost of the Bharatas, their manliness as much as possible.

sa: सदैवोष्णं विनिःश्वस्य वृद्धो दशरथो नृपः॥ विललापाविद् दुःखं गगनासक्तलोचनः।
en: Then the old king Dasaratha, with his eyes fixed at the sky, sighing hot, lamented in this strain.

sa: ततः प्रतर्दनोऽप्याह वाक्यं क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः। यथा धर्मरतिनित्यं नित्यं युद्धपरायणः॥
en: Then did that foremost among the Kshatriyas, Pratardana too, ever attached to virtue and given to war, said:

sa: दृष्ट्वा कुमारं जातं सा वार्ष्णेयी दीनमानसा। एकाग्रं चिन्तयामास किं कृत्वा सुकृतं भवेत्॥
en: The princess of the Vrishni race (Pritha) became affected with sorrow to see the birth of the child. She intently reflected on the course she should adopt.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु तस्य ता वाचो बह्वबद्धप्रलापिनः॥ इयेष स शिरश्छेत्तुं खड्नेन कुपितो नलः। स्मयंस्तु रोषताम्राक्षस्तमुवाच नलो नृपः॥
en: Having heard these expressions of that infatuated braggart, king Nala became filled with rage and desired to sever his head by the sword. King Nala smilingly, though his eyes were red with anger, addressed him, saying,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु गाङ्गेयः कुन्तीपुत्रेण धीमता। ददर्श भारतान् सर्वान् स्थितान् सम्परिवार्य ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by the highly intelligent Kunti's son the son, of Ganga opened his eyes and all the Bharatas assembled there and stood around him.

sa: कृपेण शरवर्षाणि प्रतिमुक्तानि संयुगे। सृञ्जयांश्छादयामासुः शलभानां व्रजा इव॥
en: The downpour of arrows made by Kripa in the battle covered the Srinjayas like a swarm of locusts.

sa: तस्मिन् रात्रिमुखे घोरे दुःखशोकसमन्विताः। कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणिरुपोपविविशुः समम्॥
en: At that time filled with grief and sorrow, Kritavarman and Kripa and Drona's son all sat down together.

sa: काम खलु सतां वृत्ते भ्राता ते भरतः स्थितः। ज्येष्ठानुवर्ती धर्मात्मा सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः॥ किं नु चित्तं मनुष्याणामनित्यमिति मे मतम्। सतां च धर्मनित्यानां कृतशोभि च राघव॥
en: Even though your brother Bharata ever stayed entirely by the course of the honest; he followed his elder brother; and is righteous-souled; tenderhearted; and of subdued senses. But in my opinion, the hearts of men are inconstant, and, O Rāghava, the hearts even of the virtuous change by the action of the natural impulses.

sa: तथागतां तां व्यथितामनिन्दितां व्यतीतहर्षां परिदीनमानसाम्। शुभां निमित्तानि शुभानि भेजिरे नरं श्रिया जुष्टमिवोपसेविनः॥
en: Like to servants waiting upon a wealthy person various auspicious omens waited upon Sītā of a blameless and comely person, racked with grief and divested of joy.

sa: गोपायति नरश्रेष्ठ प्रजाः सजडपण्डिताः॥ भोजनं चात्र कौरव्य प्रजाः स्वयमुपस्थितम्। सिद्धमेव महाबाहो तद्धि भुञ्जन्ति नित्यदा॥ ततः परं समा नाम दृश्यते लोकसंस्थितिः।
en: O foremost of men, it is he who protects there all mobile and immobile creatures. O descendant of Kuru, cooked food comes there of itself and all creatures eat it every day. O mighty-armed hero, next to these regions is seen the region named Shyama.

sa: सखा ते दयितो नित्यं य एष रणकर्कशः। उत्साहयति राजंस्त्वां विग्रहे पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: But this one who is ever your dear friend, who vaunts of bravery in battle and who encourages you, O king in your dispute with the Pandavas,

sa: नामधेयानि रत्नानां पुरस्तान्न श्रुतानि मे। यानि दृष्टानि मे तस्यां मनस्तपति तच्च मे॥
en: I had not even heard the names of the gems that I saw in that palace. It is for this reason my heart is so much burning.

sa: स तान् प्रति महाराज पञ्च चिक्षेप सायकान्। एकैकं हृदि चाजघ्ने एकैकेन महायशाः॥
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, the illustrious son of Somadatta sped at them five arrows and with each of those struck each of the brothers on the chest.

sa: स भूत्वा शैलसंकाशः क्षणेन पुनरात्मवान्॥ ह्रस्वतां परमां प्राप्तो बन्धनान्यवशातयत्। विमुक्तश्चाभवच्छ्रीमान् पुनः पर्वतसंनिभः॥
en: After having attained the magnitude of a mountain, that self-controlled diminished himself and cast off his bonds. And having freed himself, the graceful one again became mountain-like.

sa: अद्य त्वां निहतं बाणैः पश्यन्तु परमर्षयः। निरयस्थं विमानस्था ये त्वया निहताः पुरा॥
en: Today let those great saints, who had formerly been slain by you, stationed in the sky, behold you slain (in turn) with my arrows, and inhabiting hell.

sa: मुने कौशिक भद्रं ते सेन्द्राः सर्वे मरुद्गणाः॥ तोषिताः कर्मणानेन स्नेहं दर्शय राघवे। प्रजापतेः कृशाश्वस्य पुत्रान् सत्यपराक्रमान्॥ तपोबलभृतो ब्रह्मन् राघवाय निवेदय।
en: O ascetic, O Kusika's son, good betide you! all the Maruts with Indra at their head, have been gratified with this act (of Rāma's). Do you, O Brāhmaṇa, confer upon Raghu's descendant the sons of Prajāpati Kțśāśva, of true prowess, and charged with ascetic energy.

sa: विध्वंसयिष्यन्ति रणे मा स्म तैः सह सङ्गमः। एकैकशस्ते सम्पर्दे हन्युः सर्वान् महीक्षितः॥
en: Will destroy them in battle; let there therefore be no encounter with them. In the press of battle, each of them can alone slay the entire universe.

sa: मन्निमित्तेन मानाहः कच्चिच्छोकेन राघवः। कच्चिन्नान्धमना रामः कच्चिन्मां तारयिष्यति॥
en: Is not Rāghava, worthy of honours, beside himself with grief in my absence? Will not Rāma rescue me?

sa: एवं दुर्योधनः कर्णः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। अनेकैरभ्युपायैस्ताञ्जिघांसन्ति स्म पाण्डवान्॥
en: Thereupon, Duryodhana, Karna and the son of Subala (Shakuni) adopted numerous other means to kill that Pandava (Bhima).

sa: य एष चन्द्रार्कसमानतेजा जघन्यजः पाण्डवानां प्रियश्च। बुद्ध्या समो यस्य नरो न विद्यते वक्ता तथा सत्सु विनिश्चयज्ञः॥
en: Effulgent like the rays of the moon, the favourite and the youngest born of the Pandavas, equal to whom in intelligence no man exists or in eloquence in the midst of the assembly of the wise.

sa: ततस्तु पार्षतः क्रुद्धः शस्त्रवृष्टिं सुदारुणाम्। कृतवर्माणमासाद्य व्यसृजत् पृतनापतिः॥
en: Obtaining Kritavarma, Parsata, the commander of the forces, worked up with anger, made a terrible downpour of arrows.

sa: आजानेया बलिनः साधु दान्ता महाबलाः शूरमुदावहन्ति। एतस्य कर्माण्यतिमानुषाणि भीमेति शब्दोऽस्य गतः पृथिव्याम्॥
en: Plump, strong, well-trained and powerful horses of best breed draw that heroe's chariot; his actions are super-human; he is known on earth by the name of Bhima.

sa: सम्भ्रमस्त्यज्यतामेष सर्वैर्वालिकृते महान्। मलयोऽयं गिरिवरो भयं नेहास्ति वालिनः॥
en: Let all the monkeys renounce Vāli's fear; in this best of mountains, Malaya-there is no fear of him.

sa: ततस्तेषां नरव्याघ्र बुद्धिरासीन्महात्मनाम्। अमरा विजराश्चैव कथं स्यामो निरामयाः॥
en: O foremost of men, fell to reflecting, 'How can we become exempt from decrepitude and disease, and immortal.'

sa: पुष्करस्तु महाराज घोषयामास वै पुरे। नले यः सम्यगातिष्ठेत् स गच्छेद् वध्यतां मम॥
en: O mighty king in the meantime Pushkara had it proclaimed within the city, that any body that should regardfully (hospitably) behave towards Nala would become his victim.

sa: विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य मते तदा। जनकः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमुवाच मुनिपुङ्गवौ॥
en: Hearing Viśvāmitra's words embodying the sentiments of Vasiştha, Janaka with clasped hands addressed both the potent ascetics, saying,

sa: आसामायतनेत्राणां सुस्वराणां जनार्दन। मनःश्रुतिहरो नादो मनो मोहयतीव मे॥
en: The charming and sweet cries of those large-eyed and sweet-voiced damsels, O Krishna, are stupefying my heart greatly.

sa: दूषणस्तु स्वकं सैन्यं हन्यमानं विलोक्य च। संदिदेश महाबाहुर्भीमवेगान् दुरासदान्॥ राक्षसान् पञ्चसाहस्रान् समरेष्वनिवर्तिनः।
en: Finding his own forces slaughtered, the mighty-armed Düşaņa speedily ordered five thousand Rākşasas, gifted with tremendous velocity, difficult of being approached, who never turned from the field.

sa: ते शूलैः पट्टिशैः खङ्गैः शिलावषैर्दुमैरपि॥ शरवर्षैरविच्छिन्नं ववर्षुस्तं समन्ततः।
en: And from all sides they incessantly showered darts and pațțiśas, and scimitars, and stones, and trees, and shafts.

sa: सुव्यक्तं राजदोषो हि भविष्यति न संशयः। पुरे जनपदे चापि तथा बालवधो ह्ययम्॥
en: Evident it is therefore that undoubtedly the sin of the king has appeared in cities and provinces. And for that reason this boy has met with death.

sa: यदर्थ निर्जिता मे त्वं सोऽयमासादितो मया। नास्ति मे त्वय्यभिष्वङ्गो यथेष्टं गम्यतामिति ॥
en: The object, with which I have gained you back, has been accomplished. I have got no attachment for you-do you go wherever you wish, O gentle one.

sa: कुपितास्ते ततः सर्वे मुनयः सूर्यवर्चसः॥ ऊचुर्वसुं विमानस्थं देवपक्षार्थवादिनम्। सुरपक्षो गृहीतस्ते यस्मात् तस्माद् दिवः पत॥ अद्यप्रभृति ते राजन्नाकाशे विहता गतिः। असाच्छापाभिघातेन महीं भित्त्वा प्रवेक्ष्यसि॥ (विरुद्धं वेदसूत्राणामुक्तं यदि भवेन्नृप। वयं विरुद्धवचना यदि तत्र पतामहे।।)
en: At this answer, all the Rishis, effulgent like the Sun, became very angry. Addressing Vasu who was seated on his car and who had supported the deities, they said to him,-Since you have unfairly sided with the gods, do you fall down from heaven! From this day, O king, you shall lose the power of passing through the sky! Through our curse, you shall sink deep below the surface of the Earth.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य च तद् वर्षं निमीलित इवर्षभः॥ रामः क्रोधं परं लेभे वधार्थं सर्वरक्षसाम्।
en: Resisting that shower, Rāma with his eyes staring and resembling a bull, flew into a great rage, for the purpose of slaying the whole body of Raksasas.

sa: विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of Viśvāmitra, Rāghava, together with Laksmana, was struck with amazement, and spoke to Viśvāmitra, saying,

sa: निवेद्यमाने दोषः स्याद् दोषः स्यादनिवेदने। कथं न खलु कर्तव्यं विषमं प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: What is my course? I find myself in a false position. Things having drifted to this pass, what should I say, now that the time has come?'

sa: अथ तस्मिन्नन्तरे स उत्तङ्कः प्रविश्य उपाध्यायकुलमुपाध्यायिनीमभ्यवादयत् ते चास्यै कुण्डले प्रायच्छत्सा चैनं प्रत्युवाच॥
en: At this very time Uttanka entered the house of his preceptor and made proper salutation to his preceptress. When he presented her with the ear-rings, she said.

sa: अनिर्जित्य रणे सर्वानेतान् पुरुषसत्तमान्। अशक्यो ह्यसहायेन हन्तुं दुर्योधनस्त्वया॥
en: Without first defeating in battle all these foremost of men, you cannot, unaided as you are, kill Duryodhana.

sa: जघन्यजस्तक्षकश्च श्रुतसेनेति यः सुतः। अवसद्यो महद्युम्नि प्रार्थयन्नाममुख्यताम्॥ करवाणि सदा चाहं नमस्तस्मै महात्मने।
en: I also worship Takshaka's younger brother Shrutasena, who dwelt at the holy place called Mahadyumna with the intention of becoming one of the chiefs of the Nagas.”

sa: वाहनानि प्रभूतानि मित्राणि च कुलानि च। यावन्न तेषां गान्धारे तावद् विक्रम पार्थिव॥
en: O son of Gandhari, O king, as long as their innumerable conveyances, their friends and relatives, do not gather together, so long continue to display your prowess.

sa: सर्वत्र शूरा जायन्ते महासत्त्वा महाबलाः। प्राय एव समुद्दिष्टा लक्षणानि तु मे शृणु॥
en: It is well known that persons endued with great strength and great courage are born in almost every country. Listen to me as I describe their characteristics.

sa: अथर्भरजसः पुत्रो युधि राजन्सुदुर्जयः। गद्गदस्याथ पुत्रोऽत्र जाम्बवानिति विश्रुतः॥
en: O king, that unconquerable one in fight, Jāmbavān, is well known as the son Gadgada, king of bears.

sa: नदतां भीमघोषाणां निशासु मृगपक्षिणाम्। निशम्यमाना संत्रस्ता राघवं संश्रयिष्यति॥
en: Hearing at night the dreadful roars of birds and beasts crying, she exceedingly frightened takes shelter with Rāghava.

sa: वत्स राम चिरंजीव हतास्ते परिपन्थिनः। ज्ञातीन् मे त्वं श्रिया युक्तः सुमित्रायाश्च नन्दय॥
en: Rāma, my child, be you long-lived, and may your enemies find destruction! Furnished with this good fortune, do you gladden Sumitra's as well as my own relatives.

sa: ततः शरीरे रामस्य वासुदेवस्य चोभयोः। अन्विष्य दाहयामास पुरुषैराप्तकारिभिः॥
en: Searching out the bodies then of Rama and Vasudeva, Arjuna caused them to be burnt by expert persons.

sa: यामवाप्य महाबाहुरर्जुनः साधयिष्यति। अस्त्रहेतोर्महेन्द्रं च रुद्रं चैवाभिगच्छतु॥ वरुणं च कुबेरं चधर्मराजं च पाण्डव। शक्तो ह्येष सुरान् द्रष्टुं तपसा विक्रमेण च॥
en: Receiving it, the mighty-armed Arjuna will be able to accomplish his desire. O son of Pandu, let him go for the acquisition of weapons to Mahendra. Rudra, Varuna, Kubera and Yama. He is competent to see the celestials on account of his asceticism and prowess.

sa: निःसरन्तौ व्यद्दश्यन्त सूर्यात् सप्त महाग्रहाः॥ उल्कापाताश्च संजजुदिशां दाहास्तथैव च। शुष्काशन्यश्च सम्पेतुर्ववुर्वाताश्च भैरवाः॥
en: All the great planets including the sun seemed moving about. And the meteors were seen blazing up all the quarters. Cloudless thunders fell and fierce winds blew.

sa: षष्टि वर्षसहस्राणि षष्टिमेव शतानि च। आदित्यतापतप्तास्ते विशन्ति शशिमण्डलम्॥
en: Having been heated with the sun's rays for sixty six thousand years, they then enter the solar disc.

sa: तत्रादृश्यन्त गन्धर्वास्तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः॥ समेत्य सहिता राजन् यथाप्राप्तं यथासुखम्।
en: The Gandharvas and various clans of Apsaras are to be seen there, O king, passing their days happily.

sa: स निःश्वस्य महारोषो वाली परमवेगवान्। सर्वतश्चारयन् दृष्टिं शत्रुदर्शनकाझ्या॥
en: And the quick-paced Vali, exceedingly wroth, sighing, cast his looks around with a view to behold his enemy.

sa: त्रयाणां भरतादीनां भ्रातृणां देवता च या। रामस्य च मन:कान्ता सा कथं विनशिष्यति॥
en: Why should she that is a very goddess to the three brothers, Bharata and the others, and that has enchanted the mind of Rāma, meet with destruction?

sa: सर्प उवाच कोन्वर्जुनक दोषोऽत्र विद्यते मम बालिश। अस्वतन्त्रं हि मां मृत्युर्विवशं यदचूचुदत्॥
en: The serpent said O foolish Arjunaka, what is my fanlt? I have no will of my own, and am not independent! Death sent me on this work.

sa: सुद्युम्नस्त्वन्तपालेभ्यः : श्रुत्वा लिखितमागतम्। अभ्यगच्छत् सहामात्यः पद्भ्यामेव जनेश्वरः॥
en: Hearing from his gate-keepers that Likhita had come, king Sudyumna, with his counsellors, went out (for receiving him.)

sa: तां रात्रिमवसत् पार्थः केशवस्य निवेशने। महता शोकमोहेन सहसाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: Arjuna passed that night in the palaces of Keshava. He was suddenly overwhelmed with great sorrow and stupefaction.

sa: अर्जुनो द्रौपदेयाश्च चेकितानश्च वीर्यवान्। दुर्योधनसमादिष्टान् राज्ञः सर्वान् समभ्ययुः॥
en: Arjuna, the son of Draupadi, and the highly powerful Chekitana, rushed against the kings commanded by Duryodhana himself.

sa: तदैव निहताः कृष्ण मम पुत्रास्तरस्विनः। यदैवाकृतकामस्त्वमुपप्लव्यं गतः पुनः॥
en: I considered by energetic sons as slain even then, O Krishna, when you came back unsuccessful to Upaplavya!

sa: युद्धे येन महादेवः साक्षात् संतोषितः शिवः। तमजेयमनाधृष्यं विजेतुं जिष्णुमच्युतम्। आशंससीह समरे वीरमर्जुनमूर्जितम्॥
en: Do you wish to defeat that unconquerable, irrepressible and undetoriating Jishnu, the heroic Arjuna when enraged in battle, by whom in an encounter even Mahadeva was gratified?

sa: ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलं लङ्काधिपतये चराः। सुवेले राघवं शैले निविष्टं प्रत्यवेदयन्॥
en: Then the spies communicated to Lankā's lord news concerning Rāghava and his host stationed at the mount Suvela.

sa: तमहं न हनिष्यामि प्राणत्यागेऽपि भारत! याऽसौ प्रानिर्मिता धात्रा सैषा वै स्त्री शिखण्डिनी।।
en: Even if I were to loose my life, O Bharata, I shall not slay him. This now is the same Shikhandin whom the creator made a female.

sa: तांस्तु ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान । राघवार्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रक्षन्ति जीवितम्॥
en: As you look on, I shall describe to you those leaders who shall put forth their prowess for Rāghava, and lay down their lives in his behalf.)

sa: बहूनपि हयारोहान् भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः। रथी जघान सम्प्राप्य बाणगोचरमागतान्॥
en: A car-warrior, getting a body cavalry within shooting distance, killed many with straight arrows furnished with broad heads.

sa: स चापि तानभ्यवदत् प्रसन्न: सहैव तैर्धातृभिर्धर्मराजः। तस्थौ च तत्राधिपतिर्महात्मा दृष्ट्वा जनौघं कुरुजाङ्गलानाम्॥
en: Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) together with his brothers saluted them cheerfully in return. Seeing the concourse of the people of Kurujangala, the virtuous-minded king stayed there for some time.

sa: तस्मिन्द्वापरसंख्ये तु वर्तमाने युगक्षये। अधर्मश्चानृतं चैव ववृधे पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men, during this age two legs of piety being cut off, impiety and untruth multiplies.

sa: सर्प उवाच किल्विषी चापि मे वध्यः किल्बिषी चासि पन्नग। आत्मानं कारणं ह्यत्र त्वमाख्यासि भुजङ्गम॥ सर्व एते ह्यस्ववशा दण्डचक्रादयो यथा। तथाऽहमपि तस्मान्मे नैष दोषो मतस्तव॥
en: The serpent said He who is guilty should be killed by me, You, O serpent, are guilty! Indeed you confess it. As all these, vis., the porter's wheel, rod, and other things, are not independent causes, so I am not an independent cause! Therefore, this is no fault of mine, you should admit it.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सोपायं पूर्वमुद्दिष्टं प्रह्लादेन महात्मना। संक्षेपेण तु शीलस्य शृणु प्राप्तिं नरेश्वर॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Those means were described by the great Prahlada while discoursing to Indra. Listen, however, O king, as to how in brief conduct may be acquired.

sa: भीममाह्वायाने तु कुरुराजे महात्मानि। प्रादुरासन् सुघोराणि रूपाणि विविधान्युत॥
en: When the great king of the Kurus thus summoned Bhima to the encounter, various awful portents appeared there.

sa: तां चेच्छक्नोषि निर्मातुं कर्म चैव करिष्यसि। शृणु सर्वमशेषेण यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: If you can adopt that policy and try to exert yourself, you can still regain your prosperity. Listen attentively to all that I say to you fully.

sa: निर्विद्यति नरः कामानिर्विद्य सुखमेधते। त्यक्त्वा प्रीतिं च शोकं च लब्ध्वा बुद्धिमयं वसु॥
en: Man should renounce his desires. By acting in that way, by casting off joy and sorrow, and acquiring the wealth of knowledge, he succeeds in acquiring happiness.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततः प्रायान्मद्रराजस्य सारथिः। यत्र राजा सत्यसंधो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Thus addressed the driver, of the Madra king, proceeded where stood the righteous king Yudhishthira of sure aim.

sa: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥ अपश्यन्तो स्थानीके दुर्योधनमरिंदमम्। राजानं मृगयामासुस्तव पुत्रं महारथम्॥
en: Meanwhile not seeing that chastiser of foes Duryodhana amid the car-division, Ashvatthaman and Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satwata race, tried to find out your royal son.

sa: सम्यगेतेषु वर्तस्व त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत॥ यशः प्राप्स्यसि भद्रं ते धर्मं च सुमहत्फलम्।
en: Properly treat these three, O Bharata, you will then acquire great fame in the three worlds, and be you blessed, great will be your merit and reward.

sa: सम्प्रदुता वयं पञ्च किरीटिशरपीडिताः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं महारौद्रं तत्र नोऽभूद् रणो महान्। जितास्तेन वयं सर्वे व्यपयाम रणात् ततः॥
en: We had been cut with the arrows of Arjuna and still a fierce encounter took place between us and the army of Dhrishtadyumna. At last, defeated by the latter, all of us retreated from that battle.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु कर्णेन पाल्यमानोऽभ्ययात् तदा। हृष्टः कन्यामुपादाय नगरं नागसाह्वयम्॥
en: Protected by Karna, Duryodhana also came away, with a gladdened heart, bringing with him the maiden to Hastinapura.

sa: राधेयः कर्ण इति मां प्रवदन्ति जना भुवि। प्रसादं कुरु मे ब्रह्मन्नस्त्रलुब्धस्य भार्गव॥
en: People call me Karna the son of Radha! O you of Bhrigu's race, be propitiated with my poor self who have thus behaved for mastering the weapons.

sa: सुष्वाय जामदग्न्यस्तु विश्रम्भोत्पन्नसौहृदः। कर्णस्योत्सङ्ग आधाय शिरः क्लान्तमना गुरुः॥
en: From affection created by confidence, the tired son of Jamadagni, placing his head on Karna's lap, slept soundly.

sa: स तु राममुपागम्य शिरसाऽभिप्रणम्य च। ब्राह्मणो भार्गवोऽस्मीति गौरवेणाभ्यगच्छत॥
en: Approaching Rama, hc bowed to him and said,-I am a Brahmana of Bhrigu's race!-This secured honour for him.

sa: ते घोषिणः पाण्डवमभ्युपेयुः पर्जन्यमुक्ता इव वारिधाराः। ततः स कृष्णं च किरीटिनं च वृकोदरं चाप्रतिमप्रभावः॥ त्रिभिस्त्रिभिर्भीमबलो निहत्य ननाद घोरं महता स्वेण।
en: Those arrows came down upon the son of Pandu with hissing noise like a downpour of rain from the clouds. Then Karna of great prowess having struck Bhimsena, Janardana and Arjuna of crowned head, with three shafts which gave vent to loud and fearful roars.

sa: ततोऽस्मै तदहं सर्वमुक्तवान् ग्रहणं तदा। द्वैपायनप्रसादाच जीवतो मोक्षमाहवे॥
en: Then I described to him everything about my own capture and my release by the favour of Vyasa.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सतयेन हि स्थितो धर्म उपपत्त्या तथा परे। साध्वाचारतया केचित् तथैवौपयिकादपि॥
en: Bhishma said Some say that Righteousness is made permanent by Truth; some, by Reasoning; some, by good conduct; and some, by the application of means and contrivances.

sa: हाहाकारविनादिन्यो विनिघ्नन्त्य उरांसि च॥ शोचन्त्यस्तत्र रुरुदुः क्रन्दमाना विशाम्पते।
en: Filling the sky with exclamations of grief and beating their breasts, they cried aloud and wept, O king.

sa: हताश्च कुरवः सर्वे भीष्मद्रोणपुरःसराः। अहमेको विमुक्तस्तु भाग्ययोगाद् यदृच्छया॥
en: All the Kauravas, led by Bhishma and Drona, have died. By good luck, only I have been saved.

sa: यदीदं धर्मतो राज्यं विहितं यद्यधर्मतः। कार्यस्तत्र शोको वै भुक्ष्व भोगान् यजस्व च॥
en: Fairly or unfairly, this kingdom has not been gained by us. Our duty now is to give up grief. Do you, therefore, enjoy it and celebrate sacrifices!

sa: ततः प्रहस्य नकुलश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो रणे॥ जघान निशितैर्बाणैः सत्यसेनस्य वाजिनः।
en: Then Nakula, laughing, struck the four horses of Satyasena with four whetted and keen arrows in that encounter.

sa: ततस्त्वापततस्तस्य तव पुत्रो जनाधिप॥ बाणसंघाननेकान् वै प्रेषयामास भारता
en: Then your son, O king, discharged many arrows, O Bharata, at the Panchala prince thus rushing at hiin.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय वेगनं भारसाधनम्॥ शरैः संछादयामास समन्तात् पाण्डुनन्दनम्।
en: Satyasena, taking up another foe-slaying and powerful bow, covered the son of Pandu with arrows on all sides.

sa: तस्मिस्तु नागे धनुषि प्रयुक्ते हाहाकृता लोकपालाः सशक्राः। न चापि तं बुबुधे सूतपुत्रो बाणे प्रविष्टं योगबलेन नागम्॥
en: The son of Suta was not aware that the snake (Ashvasena) had entered his arrow by means of Yoga, but as he aimed that arrow, Shakra and other regents of the sides gave vent to lamentations.

sa: अर्जुनो भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः शिखण्डी चापराजितः॥ उत्तमौजा युधामन्युः सात्यकिश्च महारथः। पञ्चालानां च ये शिष्टा द्रौपदेयाश्च भारत॥ हयाश्च सर्वे नागाश्च शतशश्च पदातयः।
en: Arjuna and Bhimasena, the two sons of Madri by Pandu, the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna, the invincible Shikhandin, Uttamaujas, Yudhamanyu, the great carwarrior Satyaki, the five sons of Draupadi and those amongst the Panchalas, O king, that were yet alive and all the Pandavas and all their elephants and infantry by hundreds all accompanied Yudhishthira.

sa: यः पुरा हेमदण्डाभ्यां व्यजनाभ्यां स्म वीज्यते। स एष पक्षिभिः पक्षैः शयान उपवीज्यते॥
en: Formerly, he used to be fanned with a two gold-handed fans. Alas, now, his boy lunging on the ground is being fanned by birds with their wings.

sa: स भूत्वा शरणं वीरो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव! भूमौ विनिहतः शेते वातभग्न इव द्रुमः॥
en: That hero became the protector of Dhritarashtra's son, O Madhava! Alas killed, he now lies on the bare ground, like a tree struck down by the wind.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अस्मिन्नेवान्तरे वाक्ये पुनरेवार्जुनोऽब्रवीत्। निविण्णमनसं ज्येष्ठमिदं भ्रातरमच्युतम्॥
en: After this, Arjuna again said to his eldest brother of unfading glory, king Yudhishthira of cheerless heart :

sa: धिगस्तु क्रूरकृत्स्वान् कृपकर्णजयद्रथान्। द्रोणद्रौणायनी चोभौ यैरहं विधवा कृता॥
en: Alas, fie on those wicked warriors, Kripa, Karna, Jayadratha, Drona and Drona's son, by whom you were killed!

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच एवं संतज़मानस्तु मम पुत्रो महीपतिः। प्रकृत्या मन्युमान् वीरः कथमासीत् परंतपः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said "Thus remonstrated with by his enemy, how, indeed, did that scorcher of enemies, my heroic and royal son, who was angry by nature, then act.

sa: संजय उवाच अथ हैमवते प्रस्थे स्थित्वा युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्व एव महायोधास्तत्र तत्र समागताः॥
en: Sanjaya said On that table-land at the foot of the Himavat, those heroes, O king, joyous at the prospect of battle and assembled together, passed the night.

sa: देवा वै दुष्करं कृत्वा विभूतिं परमां गताः। तस्माद् गार्हस्थ्यमुद्वोढुं दुष्करं प्रब्रवीमि वः॥
en: By practising such highly difficult penances, the gods have obtained the highest glory and power. I, therefore, ask you to satisfy the heavy duties of a householder.

sa: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च भ्रातृभिः सह भारत। अनुभूय ततः पश्चात् प्रस्थातासि विशाम्पते॥
en: Having, O Bharata, acquired and enjoyed religious merit and wealth and pleasure for some time with your brothers, you may then, O king, retire into the forest.

sa: आददानस्य विजयं विग्रहं च युधिष्ठिर। समानधर्मकुशलाः स्थापयन्ति नरेश्वर॥
en: Those men only O Yudhishthira, who behave like robbers, advise a king to undertake wars and acquire victory.

sa: इतो दत्तेन जीवन्ति देवाः पितृगणास्तथा। मानुषोरगरक्षांसि वयांसि पशवस्तथा॥
en: The gifts made by you in this world support the gods, Pitris, men, Nagas, Rakshasas, birds, and animals.

sa: अस्त्राणामपि पर्यायं कर्तुमिच्छन्ति मानवाः॥ युद्धानामपि पर्यायो भवत्वनुमते तव।
en: Men wish to change weapons in battle. Let the mode of fight be changed today, with your permission.

sa: आन्तरेभ्यः परान् रक्षन् परेभ्यः पुनरान्तरान्। परान् परेभ्यः स्वान् स्वेभ्यः सर्वान् पालय नित्यदा॥१२
en: Protecting others from your own, and your own from others, as also others from others, and your own from your own, do you always maintain your subjects.

sa: अश्वत्थामा तु हार्दिक्यमपोवाह यशस्विनम्। अत शारद्वतोऽष्टाभिः प्रत्यविद्ध्यद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Then Ashvatthaman carried away the celebrated son of Hridika. Sharadvat's son struck Yudhishthira in return with eight arrows.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीताः पाण्डवाः सहकेशवाः। उपगम्योपसंगृह्य विधिवत् प्रत्यपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing him, the Pandavas, with Keshava, filled with joy, advanced towards himn and receiving him adored him properly.

sa: आश्रमेषु यथाकालं चैलभाजनभोजनम्। सदैवोपहरेद् राजा सत्कृत्याभ्यर्च्य मान्य च॥
en: The king should always honour the ascetics and present them, at proper times, with clothes, vessels and food.

sa: आसनं शयनं यानमुत्थानं पानभोजनम्। नियतं सर्वभूतानां कालेनैव भवत्युत॥
en: Seats, beds, cars, riches, drink and food, always come to living creatures in the due course of Time.

sa: वैरमुद्दीपितं राज्ञि पुत्रेण तव तन्महत्। क्लेशिताश्च वने नित्यं तत एतत् कृतं मया।।१०।
en: By this means, O queen, your son excited deadly hostilities with us. We suffered great miseries in the forest. Remembering all this, I acted in that way!

sa: भूत्वा हि नृपतिः पूर्वं समाज्ञाप्य च मेदिनीम्। कथमेकोऽद्य राजेन्द्र तिष्ठसे निर्जने वने।॥
en: You were a king who had issued your commands to all the world! Why then, O foremost of kings, do you lie alone on the bare ground?

sa: तद्राज्ये राज्यकामानां नान्यो धर्मः सनातनः। ऋते रक्षां तु विस्पशं रक्षा लोकस्य धारिणी॥
en: About those who seek kingdom, there is no other eternal duty than the protection of subjects). The protection the king grants of his subjects maintains the world.

sa: पञ्चालाश्च सवार्ष्णेयाः पाण्डवाश्च विशाम्पते। रामे द्वारावतीं याते नातिप्रमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: The Panchalas, the Vrishnis and the Pandavas. O king, became rather dispirited after Rama had started for Dvaravati.

sa: भीष्म उवाच व्यवहारेण शुद्धेन प्रजापालनतत्परः। प्राप्य धर्मं च कीर्तिं च लोकानाप्नोत्युभौ शुचिः॥
en: Bhishma said A king of pure soul and devoted to the duty of protecting his subjects acquires merit and fame, both here and hereafter, by acting righteously.

sa: यस्तु सर्वमभिप्रेक्ष्य पूर्वमेवाभिभाषते। स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी च तस्य लोकः प्रसीदति॥
en: That person who, on seeing others, speaks to them first with smiles, succeeds in winning over every one.

sa: यो हि नाभाषते किंचित् सर्वदा भृकुटीमुखः। द्वेष्यो भवति भूतानां स सान्त्वमिह नाचरन्॥
en: The person who does not speak a word and whose face is always marked with frowns is hated of all. Want of sweet speeches makes him so.

sa: स्वपलब्धा यथा लाभा वितथाः प्रतिबोधने। एवं ते क्षत्रिया राजन् ये व्यतीता महारणे॥
en: Those Kshatriyas, O king, that have been killed in this great battle, are like objects that one gets in his dreams and which disappear when one awakes.

sa: जगाम सर्वतीर्थानि पृथिव्यां चेति नः श्रुतम्। स गत्वा सरितः सर्वाः समुद्रांश्च महातपाः॥
en: Feeling great pain and with putrid matter flowing from his thigh, he travelled to all the tirthas of the earth, one after another, as heard by us.

sa: यत्रार्टिषेणः कौरव्या ब्राह्मण्यं संशितव्रतः। तपसा महता राजन् प्राप्तवानृषिसत्तमः॥
en: Touching the water of that tirtha and bathing in it, the righteous Baladeva distributed wealth amongst the Brahmanas.

sa: अश्वानन्ये गजानन्ये रथानन्ये महारथाः। आरुह्य जवसम्पन्नाः पादाताः प्राद्रवंस्तथा॥
en: Some on horse-back, some on elephants, some on cars, great car-warriors and footsoldiers, all fled away in fear.

sa: नष्टे ब्रह्मणि धर्मे च देवांस्त्रासः समाविशत्। ते त्रस्ता नरशार्दूल ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः॥
en: When both the Vedas and righteousness were lost, the gods, were overcome by fear. Overcome with fear. O foremost of men, they sought the help of Brahman.

sa: एषा ते नैष्ठिकी बुद्धिः प्रजास्वभिहिता मया। शुनो निदर्शनं तात किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि।॥
en: By mentioning the example of the dog I have instructed you about the duties you should adopt towards your subjects. What further do you wish to hear?'

sa: तमुत्पतन्तं जग्राह केशवो विनयान्वितः। बाहुभ्यां पीनवृत्ताभ्यां प्रयत्नाद् बलवद्वली॥
en: The powerful Keshava, however, ever bending with humility, caught the rushing Rama, with his massive and well-formed arms.

sa: अध्रुवे जीवलोके च स्थाने वा शाश्वते सति। जीविते मरणान्ते च कस्माच्छोचसि भारत॥
en: When this life is fickle, when this word itself is not eternal, when life is sure to end in death, why then, O Bharata, do you grieve?

sa: ततो मुहूर्तं स ध्यात्वा देवानां श्रेयसि स्थितः। सैनापत्यं ददौ तस्मै सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥
en: Having thought for a moment, the grandfather, always seeking the well-being of the celestials, conferred upon him the dignity of a generalissimo among all creatures, O Bharata.

sa: परिघं च वटं चैव भीमं च सुमहाबलम्। दहति दहनं चैव प्रचण्डौ वीर्यसम्मतौ॥
en: Ansha gave the intelligent Skanda five companions, Parigha and Vata and Bhima of great strength and Dahati and Dahana both of whom were highly dreadful and energetic.

sa: शल्यस्तु समरश्लाघी धर्मराजमरिंदमम्॥ ववर्ष शरवर्षेण शम्बरं मघवा इव।
en: Bragging Shalya poured a shower of arrows of that chastiser of foes, king Yudhishthira like Indra pouring rain.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तं भवता दण्डे वै सचराचरम्। पश्यता लोकमासक्तं ससुरासुरमानुषम्।
en: You have said that the entire universe, mobile and immobile, including gods, Asuras, and men, depends upon punishment.

sa: अहमस्य करोम्यद्य सदृशीं वैरयातनाम्। कृतघ्नस्य नृशंसस्य भृशं विश्वासघातिनः॥
en: I shall, forsooth, wreak vengeance, for this act of enmity upon this truthless and ungrateful betrayer of trust.

sa: नातिगाधे जलाधारे सुहृदः कुशलास्त्रयः। प्रभूतमत्स्ये कौन्तेय बभूवुः सहचारिणः॥
en: In shallow lake which abounded with fishes, there lived three Shakula fishes who were friends and constant companions.

sa: सर्वास्त्रविदुषां लोके श्रेष्ठस्त्वमसि विश्रुतः। न च ते जातु लोकेऽस्मिन् सुसूक्ष्ममपि किल्बिषम्।। १५
en: In this world you are celebrated as the foremost of all persons knowing the use of weapons, you have not as yet committed even a minute sin.

sa: एवं प्रज्ञावता बुद्ध्या दुर्बलेन महाबलाः॥ एकेन बहवोऽमित्राः पलितेनाभिसंधिताः।
en: Bhishma continued Thus did the wise mouse Palita, though weak, and alone, succeed in baffling many powerful enemies.

sa: कश्यप उवाच विद्धं राष्ट्र क्षत्रियस्य भवति। ब्रह्मक्षत्रं यत्र विरुद्ध्यतीह। अन्वग्बलं दस्यवस्तद्भजन्ते तथा वर्णं तत्र विदन्ति सन्तः॥
en: Kashyapa said Ruin befalls the kingdom of the Kshatriya when the Brahmana and Kshatriya fight with each other. Robbers attack that kingdom in which anarchy reigns and all good men regard the king as a Mlechchha.

sa: सात्यकिः प्रेक्ष्य समरे मद्रराजमवस्थितम्। विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing the king of the Madras stay before him in that battle, Satyaki struck him with ten arrows.

sa: यदि वा मन्यसे राजन् हतमेकं प्रतिष्ठितम्। एवमप्यशुभं कर्म न भूतं न भविष्यति॥
en: If you say it is Chance only that acts in the world, then such an act of destruction could never take place nor will ever take place.

sa: न स्मराभ्यात्मनः किंचित् पुरा संजय दुष्कृतम्॥ यस्येदं फलमोह मया मूढेन भुज्यते। दुःशासनवधं
en: I do not, O Sanjaya, remember any evil act committed by me in my pristine birth, consequences of which fool as I am, I am now suffering.

sa: सर्वमद्य यथाशक्ति तव दास्यामि सुव्रता शक्रभक्त्या च ते पाणिं न दास्यामि कथंचन॥
en: O you of excellent vows, I shall serve you, as much as I can. I will, however, not be able to marry you, for I seek Shakra.

sa: त्वं हि सौम्य कृतार्थोऽद्य निर्वृत्तार्थास्तथा वयम्॥ न तेऽस्त्यद्य मया कृत्यं किंचिदन्यत्र भक्षणात्।
en: O amiable one, your object has been accomplished. The object I had, has also been accomplished. You do not require me except to make me your food.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा करुणं वाक्यं पुत्रपौत्रवधार्दितः। पपात भुवि दुर्धर्षो वाताहत इव दुमः॥
en: Vaishampayana continued Deprived of sons, counselors and all his friends, the energetic king Dhritarashtra suddenly dropped down on the Earth like a tree uprooted by the wind.

sa: तत्र युद्धं महचासीदर्जुनस्य परैः सह। मध्यंदिनगते सूर्ये यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: At noon, that battle between one and the many, increasing the denizens of Yama's abode, became exceedingly fierce.

sa: तथैव विष्णुर्भगवान् सनातनः स चात्र देवः परिकीर्त्यते यतः। ततः स कामाँल्लभते सुखी नरो महामुनेस्तस्य वचोऽर्चितं यथा॥
en: The illustrious Vishnu has been glorified in this Parvan-therefore by reading or hearing it recited a man becomes happy and acquires all desired for objects. These words of the great Rishi Vyasa can never be false.

sa: देवदुन्दुभयश्चापि नेदुस्तत्र महास्वनाः॥ मारुतश्च ववौ पुण्यः पुण्यगन्धो विशाम्पते।
en: Celestial kettle-drums also, of loud sound, were beat there. Auspicious and perfumed breezes also blew there, O king.

sa: यद्येष बलमास्थाय न्यायेन प्रहरिष्यति। विषमस्थस्ततो राजा भविष्यति युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: If depending upon his might alone, Bhima were to fight fairly, king Yudhishthira will meet with great peril.

sa: स्थापितं च ततो देवैर्न कश्चिदतिवर्तते। तिष्ठत्येकस्य च वशे तं चेदं न विधीयते॥
en: Established by the gods, no one goes above him. It is therefore that everybody obeys one, and it is for this, that the world cannot command him.

sa: व्यास उवाच अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरस्तात विद्वान् पार्थो धनंजयः। उत्सृष्टवान्न रोषेण न नाशाय तवाहवे॥
en: Pritha's son Dhananjaya, O child, knew the use of the weapon called Brahmashira. Neither from anger, nor for your destruction in battle, did he discharge that weapon.

sa: स राजन् प्रीयमाणेन मयाप्युक्तः कृताञ्जलिः। याचमानः प्रयत्नेन मत्तोऽस्त्रं भरतर्षभ।१६।। देवदानवगन्धर्वमनुष्यपतगोरगाः। न समा मम वीर्यस्य शतांशेनापि पिण्डिताः॥
en: While with joined hands he thus begged of me my discus, myself, for pleasing him, told him these words,-Gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, men, birds and snakes, assembled together, cannot equal even a hundredth part of iny energy

sa: तं रुद्रं रौद्रकर्माणं रौद्रैः कर्मभिरच्युतम्। अभिष्टुत्य महात्मानमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Having with dreadful rites worshipped Rudra, of dreadful deeds, Ashvatthaman, with joined hands said to that high-souled deity,-

sa: अदासः क्रियते दासो ह्रियन्ते च बलात् स्त्रियः। एतस्मात् कारणाद् देवाः प्रजापालान् प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: He who is not a slave is made a slave. Women, again, are forcibly carried away. For these reasons the gods created kings for protecting the people.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि युधिष्ठिर निबोध तत्। इतिहासं सुमित्रस्य निर्वृत्तमृषभस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said I shall describe to you, O Yudhishthira, regarding it, the discourse between Sumitra and Rishabha that took place in days of yore, Listen to it!

sa: संजय उवाच ते हत्वा सर्वपञ्चालान् द्रौपदेयांश्च सर्वशः। आगच्छन् सहितास्तत्र यत्र दुर्योधनो हतः॥
en: Sanjaya said "Having killed all the Panchalas and the sons of Draupadi, the three Kuru heroes together came where Duryodhana was lying, struck down by the enemy.

sa: अथ भूयो महाराज शरेणानतपर्वणा॥ युधिष्ठिरं समाजम्ने सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
en: Again, O king, he struck Yudhishthura with a straight shaft in the very presences of all the troops.

sa: ततः शल्यो महाराज धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैर्हन्तुकामो महारथम्।
en: Then Shalya, O king, desirous of killing him, struck king Yudhishthira, a mighty carwarrior, with many sharp arrows.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि पृथगेकैकमुद्दिशन्॥ धनै रत्नैश्च गोभिश्च वस्त्रैश्च समतर्पयत्।
en: For each of these, the king pleased thousands of Brahmanas with presents of wealth, gems, kine and clothes.

sa: दुर्योधन न शोचामि त्वामहं पुरुषर्षभ। हतपुत्रौ तु शोचामि गान्धारी पितरं च ते॥
en: I do not, O foremost of men, grieve for you, O Duryodhana! I grieve only for your mother Gandhari and your father, childless as they now are.

sa: जयत्सेनं ततो विद्ध्वा नाराचेन हसन्निव॥ पातायामास कौरव्यं रथोपस्थादरिंदमः। स पपात स्थाद् राजन् भूमौ तूर्णं ममार च॥
en: Then striking Jayatsena easily with a clothyard shaft, that chastiser of foes, viz., the son of Pandu, struck down that action of Kuru's race from his car. The prince, O king, dropped down and immediately died.

sa: भगवान् पवन: स्थानाद् वृक्षानुच्चावचानपि। पर्वतानां च शिखराण्याचालयति वेगवान्॥
en: The illustrious Pavana of great speed and force unfixes the tallest and strongest trees, and even mountain summits.

sa: श्रीरुवाच नो धाता न विधाता मां विदधाति कथंचन। कालस्तु शक्र पर्यागा-मैनं शक्रावमन्यथाः॥
en: Shree said 'Neither the Creator nor the Ordainer governs me. It is Time that takes me from one place to another. Do not, O Shakra, disrespect Vali.'

sa: मनीषितं च प्राप्नोति चिन्तयन् पुरुषोत्तमम्। एकान्तभक्तिः सततं नारायणपरायणः॥
en: By thinking of the foremost of Beings, the man who is devoted whole-mindedly to Narayana, gains great wisdom.

sa: अद्यापि चैनं पश्यामि युवां पश्यन् सनातनौ।॥ यैर्लक्षणैरुपेतः स हरिरव्यक्तरूपधृक्। तैर्लक्षणैरुपेतौ हि व्यक्तरूपधरौ युवाम्॥ दृष्टौ युवां मया तत्र तस्य देवस्य पार्श्वतः।
en: Even now I see that Being in seeing you two who eternal. Those marks and indications that characterise Hari himself of unmanifest form, characterise you two who are endued with manifest forms. Verily, I see both of you by the side of that great God.

sa: नारी तु पत्यभावे वै देवरं कुरुते पतिम्। पृथिवी ब्राह्मणालाभे क्षत्रियं कुरुते पतिम्॥
en: A woman, in the absence of her husband, takes his younger brother for her lord; so the Earth, not having obtained Brahmana, made the Kshatriya her king.

sa: निर्वेदादेव निर्वाणं न च किञ्चिद् विचिन्तयेत्। सुखं वै ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्म निर्वेदेनाधिगच्छति॥ शौचेन सततं युक्तः सदाचारसमन्वितः। सानुक्रोशश्च भूतेषु तद् द्विजातिषु लक्षणम्॥
en: One may secure immersion in Brahma, by withdrawing oneself from all attachments. There is no necessity of minding any other thing. A Brahmana can easily attain to Brahma by the road of Renunciation. The marks of a Brahmana are purify, good conduct and universal benevolence.

sa: इह श्रमो भयं मोहः क्षुधा तीव्रा च जायते। लोभश्चार्थकृतो नृणां येन मुह्यन्त्यपण्डिताः॥
en: Here are to be found exhaustion, and fear, and delusion and painful hunger. here cupidity for wealth is also seen, a passion that stupefies even the learned.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच शुश्रूषध्वं ब्राह्मणेन्द्रास्त्वं च तात युधिष्ठिर। त्वं चापगेय नामानि शृणुष्वेह कपर्दिने॥
en: Vasudeva said Hear, you foremost of Brahmanas, and you Yudhishthira also, O sire, and hear you too, O River's son, the names which are applied to Kaparddin.

sa: अहं धृतिरहं सिद्धिरहं त्विड् भूतिरेव च। अहं स्वाहा स्वधा चैव संस्तुतिर्नियतिः स्मृतिः॥
en: I am Patience. I am Success, and I am prosperity. I am Svaha, I am Svadha, I am Reverence, and I am Fate, and, I am Memory.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स्पृहा स्याद् गर्हिता चैव विधित्सा चैव कर्मणाम्। आक्रोष्टा क्रुश्यते चैव वञ्चितो बुद्ध्यते स च॥
en: Bhishma said Malevolent persons always commit sinful acts and feel an irresistible inclination for doing them. They speak ill of others and are themselves censured. They always consider themselves as cheated of what is their due.

sa: तत एकाक्षरं नादं भोरित्येव समीरयन्॥ प्रत्याहरज्जगत् सर्वमुच्चैः स्थावरजङ्गमम्।
en: Thereat, the entire universe of mobile and immobile creatures, uttering the monosyllable BHO, echoed the answer of Shuka.

sa: अथ सा स्त्री भगवन्तं सुप्यतामित्यचोदयत्। तत्र वै शयने दिव्ये तस्य तस्याश्च कल्पिते॥
en: The old lady then asked the Rishi to go to bed and sleep. An excellent bed was given ts) the Rishi and another was taken by herself.

sa: कुण्डधार उवाच एतैर्लोकाः संसुरुद्धा देवानां मानुषाद् भयम्। तथैव देववचनाद् विघ् कुर्वन्ति सर्वशः॥
en: All human beings are enchained with these. The gods are afraid of men. These vices, at the order of the gods, mar and disconcert on all sides.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तानाह राक्षसेन्द्रो निशाचरान्॥ दस्यूनां दीयतामेष कृतघ्नोऽद्यैव राक्षसाः।
en: The king said to them,-Let it be so! Let this ungrateful person be forthwith delivered to the robbers.

sa: सारथिश्च यथा युक्त्वा सदश्वान् सुसमाहितः। देशमिष्टं नयत्याशु धन्विनं पुरुषर्षभ॥ तथैव नृपते योगी धारणासु समाहितः। प्राप्नोत्याशु परं स्थानं लक्षं मुक्त इवाशुगः॥
en: As a careful charioteer, O king, having yoked good horses takes the car warrior to where he likes, even so the Yogin, O king, careful in concentration, soon attains to the highest spot like an arrow shot off the bow reaching the object aimed at.

sa: जग्राह विधिवत् पाणिं तस्या ब्रह्मर्षिसत्तमः। सा च तं पतिमासाद्य परं हर्षमवाप ह॥
en: That foremost of twiceborn Rishis accepted her hand in marriage according to due rites. The princes too was wellpleased at seeing herself the wife of that Brahmana.

sa: इदं चैवापरं प्राह देवी तत्प्रियकाम्यया। निरयं नैव याता त्वं यत्र याता द्विजर्षभाः॥
en: Desiring to do good to the Brahmana, the goddess once again said to him-You shall not have to go to hell, i.e., there where great Brahmanas go.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हन्त ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम्। उदीच्यां दिशि यद् वृत्तं म्लेच्छेषु मनुजाधिप॥
en: I shall recite to you an old story the incidents of which took place in the country, O king, of the Mlecchas that lies to the north.

sa: सुखितो दुःखितो वापि नरो लाभं परित्यजेत्। अवेक्ष्य मनसा शास्त्रं बुद्ध्या च नृपसत्तम॥
en: Whether in rich circumstances or miserable, a person should renounce cupidity, meditating on the scriptures, with the help of his mind and understanding, O best of kings.

sa: ततः स राक्षसेन्द्रः स्वान् प्रेष्यानाह युधिष्ठिर। गौतमो नगरद्वाराच्छीघ्रमानीयतामिति॥
en: The king of the Rakshasas then, O Yudhishthira, ordered his attendants, saying,Bring Gautama soon here from the gate.

sa: दिव्यानि सर्वपुष्पाणि प्रववर्ष च मारुतः॥ जङ्गमाजङ्गमं चैव प्रहृष्टमभवज्जगत्।
en: The Wind-god poured there showers of celestial flowers. The entire universe, mobile and immobile, became filled with joy.

sa: अप्राशनमसंस्पर्शमसंदर्शनमेव च। पुरुषस्यैष नियमो मन्ये श्रेयो न संशयः॥
en: Forsooth, therefore, a man to acquire happiness should vow not to taste, not to touch, and to see.

sa: वणिग् यथा समुद्राद् वै यथार्थं लभते धनम्। तथा मार्णवे जन्तोः कर्मविज्ञानतो गतिः॥
en: As merchants, going across the sea, make profits according to their capital, so creatures, in this world of men, attain to ends proportionate to their respective deeds.

sa: जम्बुकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कृपणं परिदेवतः। न्यवर्तन्त तदा सर्वे शवार्थं ते स्म मानुषाः॥
en: Hearing these words of the jackal who had been thus giving vent to expressions of grief, the men turned back for the sake of the dead body.

sa: प्रधानो नाम राजर्षिर्व्यक्तं ते श्रोत्रमागतः। कुले तस्य समुत्पन्नां सुलभा नाम विद्धि माम्॥
en: There was a royal sage named Pradhana. It is clear that you have heard of him. I am born in his family, and my name is Sulabha.

sa: भैषज्यमेतद् दुःखस्य यदेतन्नानुचिन्तयेत्। चिन्त्यमानं हि चाभ्येति भूयश्चापि प्रवर्तते॥
en: The inedicine for sorrow is abstention from brooding over it. When sorrow is brooded over, it becomes multiplicd.

sa: यथा हिमवतः पाक् पृष्ठं चन्द्रमसो यथा। न दृष्टपूर्वं मनुजैन च तन्नास्ति तावता॥
en: Nobody has seen the other side of the Himavat mountains, nor the reverse of the moon's disc. Yet it cannot be said that they do not exist.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तमविकारस्थं तिष्ठन्तं निर्भयं बलिम्। अधिरूढो द्विपश्रेष्ठमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः॥
en: Seeing Vali unmoved and fearless, Indra also addressed him from the back of his king of elephants, saying,-

sa: बोध्यं शान्तमृषि राजा नाहुषः पर्यपृच्छत। निर्वेदाच्छान्तिमापन्नं शास्त्रप्रज्ञानतर्पितम्॥ उपदेशं महाप्राज्ञ शमस्योपदिशस्व मे। का बुद्धिं समनुध्याय शान्तश्चरसि निर्वृतः॥
en: O you of great wisdom, vouchsafe me those instructions which lead to tranquillity. What is that understanding which had enabled you to wander over the world in tranquillity of soul and free yourself from all acts?

sa: सोऽपि दृष्ट्वैव तं विप्रमायान्तं भाण्डजीवनः। समुत्थाय सुसंहृष्टः स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: After a long time he reached the city of Baranasi, and saw Tuladhara engaged in selling miscellaneous articles.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच ततः स प्रयतो भूत्वा मम तात युधिष्ठिर। प्राञ्जलिः प्राह विप्रर्षिर्नामसंग्रहमादितः॥
en: Vasudeva said Concentrating his mind, O Yudhishthira, the twiceborn Rishi Upamanyu, with hands joined together in respect, uttered this abstract of names beginning from the very commencement.

sa: सोऽपि शङ्करमाराध्य प्राप्तवानतुलं यशः। वेदव्यासश्च योगात्मा पराशरसुतो मुनिः॥
en: The great ascetic who is Parashara's son, viz., Vyasa bent on Yoga, has become famous by worshipping Shankara.

sa: पूजां गुरूणां सततं करोमि परस्य गुह्यं न तु भिन्नपूर्वम्। वेदाः स्वधीता मम लोकनाथ तप्तं तपो नानृतमुक्तपूर्वम्॥
en: I always adore my elders. I have never given out the secrets of others. O lord of the universe, I have studied the Vedas carefully. I have practised austere penances. I have never spoken a falsehood.

sa: अहं लक्ष्मीरहं भूति: श्रीश्चाहं बलसूदन। अहं श्रद्धा च मेधा च संनतिर्विजितिः स्थितिः॥
en: I am called Lakshmi, Bhuti, and Sree, O killer of Vala! I am Faith, I am Intelligence, I am Affluence, I am Victory, and I am Immutability.

sa: पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः। समयस्ते कृतः सौम्य लोकान्संपरिरक्षितुम्॥
en: Lord Brahmā, the father of all creatures, has said that you did promise to preserve the three worlds.

sa: अनिर्वेदः सदा कार्यो निर्वेदाद्धि कुतः सुखम्। प्रयत्नात् प्राप्यते ह्यर्थः कस्माद् गच्छथ निर्दयम्॥
en: One should always exert hopefully. How can happiness be secured from despondency? Objects of desire may be acquired by resolution. Why then do you return so heartlessly?

sa: दानमध्ययनं यज्ञस्तपो हीरार्जवं दमः॥ एतैर्वर्धयते तेजः पाप्मानं चापकर्षति।
en: Gifts, study of the Vedas, sacrifices, penances, modesty, guilelessness and selfcontrol,-these increase one's energy and dissipate one's sins.

sa: काल: काले नयति मां त्वां च कालोनयत्ययम्। तेनाहं त्वं यथा नाद्यं त्वं चापि न यथा वयम्॥
en: It is Time that leads me on in his course. That same time leads you also onward. It is, therefore, that I am not what you are to-day, and you also are not what we are.

sa: चक्षुषी सोमसूर्यो ते नासा संध्या पुनः स्मृता। ॐकारस्त्वथ संस्कारो विद्युज्जिह्वा च निर्मिता॥
en: The Sun and the Moon became his two eyes. The twilight became his nose. The syllable OM became his memory and intelligence. The lightning became his tongue.

sa: प्रीत्या शोकः प्रभवति वियोगात् तस्य देहिनः। यदा निरर्थकं वेत्ति तदा सद्यः प्रणश्यति॥
en: The sorrow of an embodied creature originates from affection which is created by separation. When, however, one learns that the dead do not come back, it disappears.

sa: स वेदे मोक्षशास्त्रे च स्वे च शास्त्रे कृतश्रमः। इन्द्रियाणि समाधाय शशास वसुधामिमाम्॥
en: He was well conversant with the Veda, with the scriptures on Liberation, and with the scriptures dealing with royal duties. Governing his senses, he ruled this Earth.

sa: अकर्मणः फलं चैव स एव परमव्ययः। छन्दांसि यस्य रोमाणि ह्यक्षरं च सरस्वती॥
en: The Highest and Immutable, He is also the fruit of abstention from all work. The Chcchandas are the hair on His body, and Pranava is His word.

sa: न ते चालयितुं शक्या धर्मव्यापारकारिणः। न तेषां भिद्यते वृत्तं यत्पुरा साधुभिः कृतम्॥
en: Those promoters of virtue cannot be seduced from the path of virtue. Their conduct, in imitation of that of virtuous men of yore, can never be otherwise.

sa: समुद्रं वा विशन्त्यन्ये नराः कामेन संयुताः। कामो हि विविधाकारः सर्वं कामेन संततम्॥
en: There are some who go into the depths of the ocean, actuated by Desire. Desire, indeed, assumes various forms. Everything is permeated by the principle of Desire.

sa: अन्तःस्थं च बहिष्ठं च साधियज्ञाधिदैवतम्। ज्ञानान्विता हि पश्यन्ति ते देवास्तात ते द्विजाः॥
en: They who have true knowledge see their own self as existing both in and out. Such men, O child, are truly twice-born and such men are gods.

sa: ममेयमिति मोहात् त्वं राजश्रियमभीप्ससि। नेयं तव न चास्माकं न चान्येषां स्थिरा सदा॥
en: Actuated by folly you consider your present regal prosperity as yours. Know, however, that it is not permanent either for me or for you or for others.

sa: सर्वं पश्यति यद् दृश्यं मनोयुक्तेन चक्षुषा। मनसि व्याकुले चक्षुः पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति॥
en: What the living agent sces with eyes acting in unison with the mind, the eye sees not, even when lying before it, if the mind elsewhere engaged.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स लब्ध्वा परमं देवाद् वरं सत्यवतीसुतः। अरणी सहिते गृह्य ममन्थाग्निचिकीर्षया॥
en: Bhishma said Having got this high boon from the great God, the son of Satyavati, was one day engaged in rubbing his sticks for making a fire.

sa: त्वं हि संहारबुद्ध्या मे चिन्तिता रुषितेन च। तस्मात् संहर सर्वांस्त्वं प्रजाः सजडपण्डिताः॥
en: Filled with ire and resolved to encompass the destruction of created beings, I have called you. Do you, there, begin to destroy all creatures foolish or learned.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य वर्णेन यदि वर्णो विभिद्यते। सर्वेषां खलु वर्णानां दृश्यते वर्णसंकरः॥
en: Bharadwaja said If the distinction between the four castes be made by means only of colour, then it seems that all the four orders have been intermixed.

sa: न पाणिभ्यां न बाहुभ्यां पादोरुभ्यां च चानघ। न गात्रावयवैरन्यैः स्पृशामि त्वां नराधिप॥
en: I have not touched you, O king, with my hands, or arms, or feet, or thighs, O sinless One, or with any other part of the body.

sa: स तेनाढ्यो महायोगी तपसा च धनेन च। व्यराजत महाराज त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्॥
en: That foremost of Yogins. (viz., Ushanas), rich with that wealth of penances and the wealth (of Kuvera), shone brightly in the three worlds, gifted with great energy.

sa: असितो देवलस्तात वाल्मीकिश्च महातपाः। मार्कण्डेयश्च गोविन्दे कथयन्त्यद्भुतं महत्॥
en: Asita-Devala, O son, Valmiki of austere penances and Markandeya, describe Govinda as the most Wonderful and the Supreme.

sa: शुद्धां गतिं तां परमां परैति शुद्धेन नित्यं मनसा विचिन्वन्। ततोऽव्ययं स्थानमुपैति ब्रह्म दुष्प्रापमभ्येति स शाश्वतं वै॥
en: Enquiring with a purified mind, individual soul attains to a high and pure end. Thence he attains to a spot which knows no destruction, and thence attains to eternal Brahma which is so difficult of acquisition.

sa: तद् वयं सहिता गत्वा भीष्ममाशु नरोत्तमम्। नचिरात् सर्वे वार्ष्णेय मन्त्रं पृच्छाम कौरवम्॥
en: So, O descendant of the Vrishni race, repairing speedily with you to that foremost of men Bhishma, we shall seek counsel from that descendant of Kuru's race.

sa: अस्त्रमस्त्रेण संवार्य प्राणदद् विसृजञ्छरान्। धृष्टद्युम्नश्च भीमश्च सात्यविश्च महारथः॥
en: Meanwhile Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima and Satyaki, these mighty car-warriors, having approached Karna, pierced him each with three straight-flying arrows.

sa: अलम्बुषस्तु समरे भैमसेनि महाबलम्। बहुधा दारयामास शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Alambusha, in that great battle, wounded the mighty son of Bhimasena (Ghototkacha) in many places with straight arrows.

sa: ते मां रक्षत संग्रामे मा वो मूर्ध्नि धनंजयः। पदं कृत्वाऽऽनुयाल्लक्ष्यं तस्मादत्र विधीयताम्॥
en: Do you all therefore protect me in battle. Let not Dhananjaya, placing his feet on your heads, succeeded in hitting his target. Let suitable arrangements be made.

sa: पतिताः पात्यमानाश्च प्रत्यदृश्यन्त सर्वशः। वध्यमाना हयाश्चैव प्राद्रवन्तः भयार्दिताः॥
en: Were seen fallen and falling. When being thus slaughtered, the horses began to fly away struck with terror,

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा पार्थः केशवेन महात्मना। भगदत्तं शितैर्बाणैः सहसा समवाकिरत्॥
en: Thus spoken to by the high-souled Keshava, Pritha's son suddenly covered Bhagadatta with a shower of sharp arrows.

sa: ततः पार्थो महाबाहुरसम्भ्रान्तो महामनाः। कुम्भयोरन्तरे नागं नाराचेन समार्पयत्॥
en: Then the mighty-armed and high-souled Arjuna dauntlessly wounded Bhagadatta's clephant between its frontal globes with a (long) lance.

sa: स तया वीरघातिन्या गदया गदिनां वरः। गौतमस्य हयान् हत्वा सारथिं च न्यपातयत्॥
en: Then that foremost of all wielders off maces slaying the steeds of the son of Gautami with that mace capable of crushing herces, felled the latter's charioteer.

sa: युद्धकाले पुनः प्राप्ते तदैव भवता यदि। निवर्तिताः स्युः संरब्धा न त्वां व्यसनमाव्रजेत्॥
en: If, again, on the eve of the battle, you had prevented the enraged parties from joining in the battle, then this calamity would not have overtaken you.

sa: एवमुक्तश्च तेनासौ ब्राह्मणौ राजसत्तम। दूतः प्रयातो नगरं दाशार्णनृपचोदितः॥
en: Thus addressed, that Brahmana messenger, dispatched by that Dasharna king, traveled towards the city, O best of kings.

sa: तेषामपि महोत्सेधाः शोभयन्तो रथोत्तमान्॥ भ्राजमाना व्यरोचन्त जाम्बूनदमया ध्वजाः।
en: The golden standards of these warriors, beautifully placed at the flag-staff of thcir excellent cars looked highly effulgent.

sa: हतान् भ्रातॄन् पितॄन् पुत्रान् सुहत्सम्बन्धिबान्धवान्। उत्सृज्योत्सृज्य संजग्मुस्त्वरयन्तो हयद्विपान्॥
en: Abandoning their slain brothers, fathers, sons, friends, relatives and kinsmen, they fled urging their elephants and steeds on.

sa: हते तु भीष्मे राधेय पुनरेष्यसि संयुगम्। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य साहाय्यं यदि पश्यसि चेत् समम्॥
en: O son of Radha, when Bhishma will be killed, you may come back and fight on Duryodhana's side, if you have no particular lcaning for any party.

sa: न नूनं परदुःखेन म्रियते कोऽपि संजय। यत्र द्रोणमहं श्रुत्वा हतं जीवामि मन्दधीः॥
en: Surely, O Sanjaya, no man ever dies through sorrow caused by another's calamity; since, I, unfortunate as I am, am still alive having heard of Drona's death.

sa: अक्षौहिण्याथ पाञ्चाल्यो यज्ञसेनो महामनाः। विराटमन्वयात् पश्चात् पाण्डवार्थं पराक्रमी॥
en: The illustration Yajnasena the greatly powerful Panchala king placed himself behind Virata (king) with one Akshauhini of soldiers.

sa: काञ्चनाङ्गदकेयूरैः कार्मुकैश्च महारथाः। भ्राजमाना व्यराजन्त साग्नयः पर्वता इव॥
en: The great car-warriors adorned with golden bracelets and armlets looked as effulgent as so many hills of fire.

sa: वासुदेवश्च भगवान् पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम तम्। तथा मुख्याश्च राजानस्तच्चित्ता जग्मुरुत्सुकाः॥
en: The lord Vasudeva also followed him. The chief kings also (of Yudhisthira's army) followed him in great anxiety.

sa: तौ दृष्ट्वा दृष्टद्युम्नवृकोदरौ। कलिङ्गान् समरे वीरौ योधयेतां मनस्विनौ॥
en: Seeing Satyaki at a distance, those two greatly powerful heroes Dhrishtadyumna and Vrikodara furiously fell upon the Kalingas.

sa: श्रुतं ते गदतो वाक्यं सर्वमेव यथातथम्। तथा कर्तास्मि कौरव्य यथा त्वमनुशासि माम्॥
en: The words uttered by you have all been heard by me, let them be so; I shall, O Kauravya, do what you have instructed me to do.

sa: ततो दुःशासनं भूयः स्मयमान इवाब्रवीत्॥ अतिविद्धः शितैर्बाणैर्भृशं गाण्डीवधन्वना।
en: Thus pierced with sharp arrows by the wielder of the Gandiva, Bhishma once more addressing Dushasana smilingly said:

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रभाते विमले धार्तराष्ट्रेण चोदिताः। दुर्योधनेन राजानः प्रययुः पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then, the next morning, when all was cloudy, all the kings, advanced against the son of Pandu, being excited by Duryodhana the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: जयं प्राप्तेषु हृष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञः पिता देवव्रतस्तव॥
en: And when the illustrious Pandava had won the victory, your father Devavrata learned in the precepts of morality.

sa: क्षमं च मन्यसे युद्धं मम तेनाद्य संयुगे। परवानस्मि भवति प्रेष्यवद् रक्ष मद्यशः॥
en: How it is that you today think me competent to fight with him? I am entirely dependent on you and am your slave; Oh! save my honour!

sa: प्रापयामास राजेन्द्र सह तेन शिखण्डिना। तां पूजां नाभ्यनन्दतं स वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: And (the Panchala king) went up to him along with Shikhandin, O great king. But he (the messenger) did not accept that homage, but said these words,

sa: बहूनीह विकुर्वाणो दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि संयुगे॥ अपीडयत् क्षणेनैव द्रोणः पाण्डवसृञ्जयान्।
en: In the encounter, invoking various celestial weapons Drona, in a moment, sorely oppressed the Pandavas and the Srinjayas.

sa: वयमप्युत्सहेम द्यां खं च गच्छेम मायया। रसातलं विशामोऽपि ऐन्द्र वा पुरमेव तु॥
en: Who can venture to go to heaven and to the say by the help of illusion and can enter even Rasatala and even the capital of Indra?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हन्त तस्मान्महाबाहो बधोपायं वदात्मनः। आचार्य प्रणिपत्यैष पृच्छामि त्वां नमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: Yudhishthira said O mighty-armed one, tell us the means of your death. O preceptor, prostrating myself to your feet I ask you this. I bow to you.

sa: ततः सरथनागाश्वा: समकम्पन्त सुंजयाः। मृत्योरास्यमनुप्राप्तं मेनिरे च युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Then the Srinjayas with their cars, elephants and steeds, began to quake (with inside the jaws of Death.

sa: पुनश्चैव वसातीयाञ्जघान रथिनो दश। केकयानां रथान् सप्त हत्वा च दश कुञ्जरान्॥ दौः शासनिरथं सावं गदया समपोथयत्।
en: Next he slew ten car-warriors of the clan of Brahma-vasatiya; and then seven warriors of the Kekayas and then ten huge elephants. Then he pressed down upon the ground the car and horses of Dushasana's son.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु संक्रुद्धो मागधं समचोदयत्। अनीकं दशसाहस्रं कुञ्चराणां तरस्विनाम्॥
en: Duryodhana however wrought up with anger urged against Bhima the Magadha division consisting of ten thousands swiftcoursing elephants.

sa: भिन्नेषु तेषु व्यूहेषु क्षत्रिया इतरेतरम्। एकमेकं समाहूय युद्धायैवावतस्थिरे॥
en: When the arrays were thus shattered by Bhishma, the Kshatriyas challenging one another encountered one another for battle.

sa: तथैव तव पुत्रोऽपि सर्वोद्योगेन मारिष। विन्दानुविन्दौ समरे परिवार्यावतस्थिवान्।॥
en: So also, O sire, your sons putting forth all their energies, remained in battle surrounding Vinda and Anuvinda.

sa: समरे समरश्लाघिन् न त्वया सदृशोऽभवत्॥ ब्रह्मण्यः सत्त्वयोधी च तेजसा च बलेन च।
en: Ever boastful in battle, could never cope with you in fight. You are devoted to the Brahmanas, you always love fair fight. In prowess and in might,

sa: उपगम्य तु ते सर्वे बिडालमिदमब्रुवन्। भवत्प्रसादादिच्छामश्चर्तं चैव यथासुखम्॥
en: And they having all approached the cat said this. Through your grace we desire to roam about happily.

sa: अभिमन्युः सुसंक्रुद्धः पिशङ्गैस्तुरगोत्तमैः। संयुक्तं रथमास्थाय प्रायाद् भीष्मरथं प्रति॥
en: Thereupon Abhimanyu angrily rushed towards Bhishma's car on his own car yoked with excellent horses of brown colour.

sa: भीमसेनं पुरस्कृत्य दुर्योधनमुपाद्रवन्। नानाविधानि शस्त्राणि विसृजन्तो जये धृताः॥
en: Placing Bhimasena at their head, are rushing at Duryodhana, hurling diverse kinds of weapons, determined to secure success,

sa: द्रौणिस्तु रभसः शूरस्गर्तादनु भारत। प्रययौ सिंहनादेन नादयानो धरातलम्॥
en: After Trigarta, O Bharata, the valiant son of Drona rushed to battle, resounding the earth with his war-cries.

sa: बलं तपश्च सत्यं च कर्म धर्मात्मकं तव। तेजोऽग्निः पवनः श्वास आपस्ते स्वेदसम्भवाः॥
en: Asceticism and truth born of acts of piety constitute your strength. Your energy is fire, your breath the wind. And waters have been created from your perspiration.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् कुमारस्य रणे विक्रीडितं महत्। बिभित्सतो रथानीकं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, 0 king, of the wonderful achievements of the prince (Abhimanyu), when he was engaged in breaking through the cardivision protected by by Bharadvaja's himself.

sa: संजय उवाच गतपूर्वाह्नभूयिष्ठे तस्मिन्नहनि दारुणे। वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे महावीरवरक्षये॥ दुर्मुखः कृतवर्मा च कृपः शल्यो विविंशतिः। भीष्मं जुगुपुरासाद्य तव पुत्रेण चोदिताः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, when the greater part of that fearful day passed away, Durmukha, Kritavarma, Kripa, Shalya and Vivingshati, urged by your son, came to Bhishma and began to protect him in that fearful battle which was so destructive of the foremost of men.

sa: कुले जातस्य धीरस्य क्षत्रियस्य विशेषतः। सदृशं मरणं ह्येतत् तव पुत्रस्य मा शुचः॥
en: This sort of death is worthy of your son, born in an illustrious family, modest and especially belonging to the Kshatriya order. Do not grieve for him.

sa: ततो कृच्छ्रगतं कर्णे दृष्ट्वा कर्णादनन्तरः॥ सौभद्रमभ्ययात् तूर्णं दृढमुद्यम्य कार्मुकम्। तत उच्चुक्रुशुः पार्थास्तेषां चानुचरा जनाः। वादित्राणि च संजघ्नुः सौभद्रं चापि तुष्टुवुः॥
en: Seeing Karna in such a plight his younger brother, stretching his bow with great force impetuously rushed at Subhadra's son. At this, the Parthas sent up a loud uproar; their followers beat and blew many musical instruments; and they all applauded the sons of Subhadra.

sa: सम्बन्धकं चैव समर्थ्य तस्मिन् दाशार्णके वै नृपतौ नरेन्द्र। काग्रो निश्चयं वै जगाम॥
en: Although he had himself deceived the king of the Dasharna country, yet sanctioning the alliance as quite proper, he began to settle his plans with concentrated attention.

sa: बृहद्बलात् ततः शूरस्त्रिगर्तः प्रस्थलाधिपः। काम्बोजैर्बहुभिः सार्धं यवनैश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: After Brihadbala came the heroic Bhagadatta, the ruler of Prasthala, accompanied by numerous Kamboja and thousands of Yavanas.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच पुत्रं पुरुषसिंहस्य संजयाप्राप्तयौवनम्। रणे विनिहतं श्रुत्वा भृशं मे दीर्यते मनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Hearing of the death of the youthful son of that foremost of men (Arjuna), my heart, O Sanjaya, seems to be split up into pieces.

sa: गजाः पदाता रथिनस्तुरगाश्च विशाम्पते। व्यतिष्ठन् वागुराकाराः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: O king, elephants, foot soldiers, carwarriors and horseman stood there by hundred and thousands like a net work,

sa: तदपास्य धनुश्च्छिन्नं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय वेगवद् बलवत्तरम्॥
en: Thereupon, the son of Kunti, took up another bow which was stronger and capable of imparting greater velocity.

sa: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रतिज्ञां परिपालयन्। चित्राङ्गदं भ्रातरं वै महाराज्येऽभ्यषेचयम्॥
en: Then did I, O chief among the Bharatas, observing my vows, install my brother Chitrangada on the throne.

sa: नामभिस्ते मनुष्येन्द्र पूर्वं योधाः परस्परम्। युद्धाय समवर्तन्त समाहूयेतरेतरम्॥
en: Then, O foremost of men, challenging one another by their appellation, the warriors became engaged with one another.

sa: दशमेऽहनि सम्प्राप्ते ततस्तां रिपुवाहिनीम्। कीर्यमाणां शितैर्बाणैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: When the tenth day arrived, Bhishma scattered the hostile army with his whetted shafts, by hundreds and thousands.

sa: अथवा मत्प्रसूत: स स्वस्रीयो माधवस्य च॥ सुभद्रायां च सम्भूतो न चैवं वक्तुमर्हति।
en: "Or it may be, that being begotten by myself and being the nephew of Madhava, being born out of Subhadra's womb, he did not utter such exclamations.

sa: यो मां नित्यमदीनात्मा प्रत्युद्गम्याभिनन्दति॥ उपायान्तं रिपून हत्वा सोऽद्य मां किं न पश्यति।
en: He of generous soul who everyday used to come out to receive me when I returned after having slain my foes, will he not see me today?

sa: यदीदं कत्थनाल्लोके सिध्येत् कर्म धनंजय। सर्वे भवेयुः सिद्धार्थाः कत्थने को हि दुर्गतः॥
en: If, O Dhananjaya, people in the world were to succeed owing to boasting then all would have their objects gained for who would be slow to boast.

sa: भयाद् रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः। येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्॥
en: And all great car warriors will think that you abstain from the battle through fear. You will be lightly thought of by those who honoured you before.

sa: सुभद्रः वक्ष्यते किं मामभिमन्युमपश्यती॥ द्रौपदी चैव दुःखाते ते च वक्ष्यामि किं त्वहम्।
en: Oh! what will Subhadra say to me when she will not behold Abhimanyu (her son)! Alas, what also shall I tell to Draupadi overwhelmed with great grief?

sa: प्रहृष्टमनसः शूराः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। अभ्यवर्तन्त निघ्नन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: The heroic Pandavas, O elder brother of Pandu, with cheerful hearts, advanced slaying the forces of your son,

sa: पत्तिसङ्घा हयारोहैः सादिसङ्घाश्च पत्तिभिः। पात्यमाना व्यदृश्यन्त शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: It has been seen there that innumerable foot-soldiers were cut down by horse-riders and horse-riders cut down foot-soldiers,

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः। तव सैन्यं समासाद्य पीडयामासुरोजसा॥
en: Then Nakula, Sahadeva, and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki, all approaching your troops began to afflict them with force.

sa: तस्य ते न व्यथां काञ्चिदिह पश्यामि भारत। यस्य ते जयमाशास्ते विश्वभुक् त्रिदिवेश्वरः॥
en: Therefore I do not find any cause for sorrow., You have the lord of the universe and the lord of the celestial to which victory to you.

sa: ह्रीमन्तः सर्वशास्त्रज्ञा ज्ञानतृप्ता जितेन्द्रियाः। यां गतिं साधवो यान्ति तां गति व्रज पुत्रक॥
en: O son, may you attain that end which they attain who are modest, learned in all the Shastras, content in knowledge and hold their passions under check.

sa: युधिष्ठिरो द्वादशभिः प्रत्यविध्यत् पितामहम्। द्रोणस्तु सात्यकि विद्ध्वा भीमसेनमविध्यत॥
en: Then Yudhishthira pierced the grandsire in return with twelve shafts. Drona having pierced Satyaki began to pierce Bhima,

sa: संजय उवाच युध्यतामेव तेषां तु भास्करेऽस्तमुपागते। संध्या समभवद् घोरा नापश्याम ततो रणम्॥
en: Sanjaya said While they were thus fighting and when the sun set, the pall of hideous twilight enveloped the earth, and the battle became lost of view.

sa: तेषां दुर्योधनो राजा ससैन्यानां महात्मनाम्। व्यादिदेश सवाह्यानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: And king Duryodhana ordered provisions of the best kind for high-souled (warriors) with their forces, consisting of infantry.

sa: बाह्रीकं तु रणे क्रुद्धं क्रुद्धरूपो विशाम्पते। अभ्यद्रवदमेयात्मा धृष्टकेतुर्महारथः॥
en: O king, that high-souled great car-warrior Dhrishtaketu angrily rushed upon Balhika who was the very embodiment of anger.

sa: को ह्यस्ति जीविताकाक्षी प्राप्येममरिमर्दनम्। पार्थो वा इतरो वापि कोऽन्यः स्वस्ति गृहान् व्रजेत्॥
en: Who is there, the son of Pritha or any body else, who, having fought with this grinder of foes, would return home with life and in health,

sa: विसृजन्तो बहून् बाणान् क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः। भीमसेनमभिद्रुत्य विव्यधुः सहिता भृशम्॥
en: With their eyes coppery in rage, and shooting myriads of shafts, they rushed against Bhimasena, piercing him simultaneously.

sa: पतितान्युत्तमाङ्गानि बाहवश्च विभूषिताः। व्यचेष्टन्त महीं प्राप्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of heads and arms adorned with ornaments, feil on the ground and moved in convulsions.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवस्त्वदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः। देवानपि रणे जेतुं समर्था इति मे मतिः॥
en: These and many others, prepared to lay down their very lives for your sake, are I consider, capable of obtaining victory even over the gods in battle.

sa: ततोऽहं पुनरेवायथ तानष्टौ ब्रह्मवादिनः। अद्राक्षं दीप्यमानान् वै ग्रहानष्टाविवोदितान्॥
en: And then I again saw those eight revealers of Brahmana, blazing like eight constellations risen (in the sky).

sa: अग्निनेव प्रदग्धानि वनानि शिशिरात्यये॥ शरदग्धान्यदृश्यन्त सैन्यानि द्रुपदस्य ह। अत्यतिष्ठद् रणे भीष्मो विधूम इव पावकः॥ मध्यंदिने यथाऽऽदित्यं तपन्तमिव तेजसा। न शेकुः पाण्डवेयस्य योधा भीष्मं निरीक्षितुम्॥
en: As a forest in consumed by fire at the end of winter, so were the troops of Drupada scen to be consumed (by Bhishma). Bhishina stood in that battle like a blazing fire without smoke, or like the sun at mid-day, scorching every thing around. The Pandava troops could not even look at Bhishma.

sa: तूर्याणि शतसंख्यानि तथैव नटनर्तकाः। शिल्पिनश्च तथाऽऽजग्मुः कुरुवृद्धं पितामहम्॥
en: Trumpeters, courtesans, mimes, actors and dancers and artisans, in crowds repaired to that venerable grandsire of the Kurus.

sa: नीलात् परतरं श्वेतं श्वेताद्धैरण्यकं परम्। वर्षमैरावतं राजन् नानाजनपदावृतम्॥
en: Beyond the Nila (mountain) is Shveta; beyond Shveta is Hiranyaka, beyond Hiranyaka is Airavata abounding in many countries.

sa: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्। भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः॥
en: And again all things are not in Me. See my divine power. Supporting all entities and producing all entities, My Self does not live in those entities.

sa: यदीदं कत्थनाल्लोके सिध्येत् कर्म धनंजय। सर्वे भवेयुः सिद्धार्थाः कत्थने को हिं दुर्गतः॥
en: If, O Dhananjaya, people in the world were to succeed owing to boasting then all would have their objects gained for who would be slow to boast.

sa: तत उच्चुक्रुशुः सर्वे पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह। धृष्टद्युम्नेन तत् कर्म कृतं दृष्ट्वा सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Seeing that very great difficult feat achieved by Dhrishtadyumna, the Panchalas and the Pandavas were all filled with delight. They, again and again, sent forth loud shouts.

sa: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति। कौन्तेय प्रति जानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति॥
en: Such a man soon becomes devout and virtuous minded, and attains eternal peace. Learn, O son of Kunti, he who is devoted to Me, is never lost.

sa: ततः सम्प्रेषयामास दुपदोऽपि महात्मने। हिरण्यवर्मणे दूतं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम्॥
en: King Drupada then despatched a Brahmana messenger, versed in all the Vedas to the high-souled golden armored one.

sa: एष पाण्डुसुतो वीरः कृष्णेन सहितो बली। तथा करोति सैन्यानि यथा कुर्याद् धनंजयः॥
en: “This mighty and heroic son of Pandu Dhananjaya, accompanied as he is by Krishna, is treating our troops as he alone is able to deal with them.

sa: न चापि सहिता वीरा देवदानवराक्षसाः॥ मां चापि शक्ता निर्जेतुं किमु मर्त्या महारथाः।
en: Regarding me, I may say that all the heroic celestial, Danavas and Rakshasas, united together, can not vanquish me in battle, what to speak of human car-warriors?"
