sa: मम चैव समक्षं तां कन्यामाहूय भार्गवः। उक्तवान् दीनया वाचा मध्य तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Then in my presence, summoning that maiden (the daughter of Kashi), the descendant of Bhrigu, spoke (to her) in these modest words, before all the high-souled ones.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततस्ते तपासाः सर्वे कार्यवन्तोऽभवंस्तदा। तां कन्यां चिन्तयन्तस्ते किं कार्यमिति धर्मिणः॥
en: Bhishma said Then did all those anchorites engage themselves in their respective duties and those virtuous ones thought as to what they should do for that lady.

sa: क्षरन्त इव जीमूताः प्रभिन्नकरटामुखाः। राजानमन्वयुः पश्चाच्चलन्त इव पर्वताः॥
en: With temporal juice flowing down and with the temples rent, followed the king like so many moving mountains.

sa: समन्तपञ्चकाद् बाह्यं शिविराणि सहस्रशः। कारयामास विधिवत् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The son of Kunti Yudhishthira ordered tents to be pitched duly be thousands beyond the region called Samantapanchaka.

sa: राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च तथान्ये पिशिताशिनः। समन्ततो व्यदृश्यन्त शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Rakshasas, and Pishachas and other feeders on flesh were seen on all sides by hundreds and by thousands.

sa: यस्माज्जानन् स मन्दात्मा मामसौ नोपसर्पति। तस्मात् तस्मै महादण्डो धार्यः स्यादिति मे मतिः।।३९।
en: As this fool does not approach me, though knowing (that I am here), therefore he should be inflicted on a severe punishment. This is what I think.

sa: त्वं चापि रथिनां श्रेष्ठः स्वयं शूरोऽमिताते। स कथं पाण्डवेयेभ्यो भयं पश्यसि सैन्धव॥
en: You also, O you of unrivalled effulgence, are the foremost of all heroes; why then, O ruler of the Sindhus, do you entertain fear from the Pandavas.

sa: पाण्डवानां तु सैन्येषु नास्ति कश्चित् स भारत। दधार योरणे बाणान् द्रोणचापच्युतान् प्रभो॥
en: There was none, O Bharata, in the host of the Pandavas who could bear the arrows in that battle, shot, O lord, from the bow of Drona.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम चित्ररूपं विशाम्पते॥ दुःशासनरथं प्राप्य यत् पार्थो नात्यवर्तत।
en: Then, O monarch, we beheld a wonderful incident, namely that reaching Dushasana's car Partha could not advance further.

sa: ऋद्धं गृहं सर्वकामैर्यच मे वसु किंचन। तत् सर्वमस्मै सत्कृत्य प्रयच्छामि न चेच्छति॥
en: Then I offered him a beautiful palace abounding in all objects of desire, in fact, whatever riches I had but still he refused to accept the gift.

sa: समरे शरसंवीता भारद्वाजेन मारिष। चेकितानरथं दृष्ट्वा हताश्वं हतसारथिम्॥
en: Then, O sire, beholding the horseless and the driverless chariot of Chekitana covered with Drona's arrow in battle.

sa: तथा तु नर्दमाने वै भीमसेने मदोत्कटे। स्मितं कृत्वा महाबाहुधर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ हृद्गतं मनसा प्राह ध्यात्वा धर्मभृतां वरः।
en: While the furious Bhima was thus roaring the mighty-armed Yudhishthira that foremost of all virtuous persons, that son of Dharma, reflected smilingly for a while and then thus worded the thought that then filled his heart.

sa: तौ तु स्थितौ महाराज समरे युद्धशालिनौ। अन्योन्यं प्रतिसंरब्यावन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणौ॥
en: O king, in that battle those two brave warriors well skilled in warfare, determined to kill each other.

sa: अविषह्यं ततो दृष्ट्वा राधेयं युधि योधिनः। भीमसेनमुपागच्छन् कर्णबाणप्रपीडिताः॥
en: Thereupon seeing the son of Radha irrepressible in battle all those warriors, assailed by Karna's shafts, approached Bhimasena.

sa: ततः कर्णो महाराज पाण्डुसैन्यान्यशातयत्। तूलराशि समासाद्य यथा वायुर्महाबलः॥
en: O king, then Karna fell on the Pandava army as the violent wind disperses a pack of cotton.

sa: अवमन्य च हंसांस्तानिदं वचनमब्रुवन्॥ योऽसावुत्पतितो हंसः सोऽसावेवं प्रहीयते।
en: Thereat disregarding the swans the crows said-"That swan amongst us who has soared high up is evidently defeated."

sa: देशांश्च विविधांश्चित्रान् पूर्ववृत्तांश्च पार्थिवान्। ब्राह्मणः कथयन्ति स्म धृतराष्ट्रनिवेशने॥
en: In Dhritarashtra's house the Brahmanas used to describe many pleasant regions and the lives of many ancient kings.

sa: दैवोपसृष्टः पुरुषो यत् कर्म कुरुते वचित्। कृतं कृतं हि तत्कर्म दैवेन विनिपात्यते॥
en: O king, whatever act, a person who is not favoured by fate, does, it is baffled by fate, in spite of all his exertions to accomplish it.

sa: दशभिर्दशाभिश्चैको नाराचैर्निहतो गजः। न चासौ धार्तराष्ट्राणां श्रूयते निनदस्तथा॥ पुरंदरसमे क्रुद्धे निवृत्ते भरतर्षभ।
en: The other elephants were killed each with ten Narachas. The war-cries of Dhritarashtra's soldiers are no longer audible since (Bhima), like Purandara himself, is engaged in battle.

sa: तिष्ठस्तव तावत् सुप्रीतो यावत् कर्ण वधाम्यहम्॥ एवमुक्त्वा ततः प्रायात् कर्णं प्रति नरेश्वर।
en: Do you live without any anxiety whatever up to the time I do not slay Karna." Having thus spoken, O foremost of men, he rushed against Karna.

sa: किमर्थं समरे सैन्यं वासुदेवो न्यवारयत्॥ किमर्थं च भवान् सैन्यं न हनिष्यति मारिष।
en: O sire, for what reason should Vasudeva restrain your forces in the field of battle; and for what reason also you will not slaughter the hostile ariny.

sa: तस्येन्द्रजप्लावततं समीक्ष्य पार्थो राजन् गाण्डिवमाददे सः। ऐन्द्रं जालं प्रत्यहरत् तरस्वी वरास्त्रमादाय महेन्द्रसृष्टम्॥
en: Beholding those weapons of Indra about to fall on him Partha took up his Gandiva and speedily baffled them with an arrow created for him by Vasava.

sa: एष गच्छामि संग्रामं त्वत्कृते कुरुनन्दन॥ योत्स्येऽहं शत्रुभिः सार्धं जेष्यामि च वरान् वरान्।
en: O foremost of Kurus, I am now going to fight for your sake. I will engage with your foes and destroy a large number of your enemies.

sa: तत्र वै ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा ततो भवति क्षत्रियः। वैश्यः शूद्रश्च वाहीकस्ततो भवति नापितः॥
en: That one at first becomes a Brahmana and then becomes a Kshatriya, A Vahika after that will become a Vaishya, then a Sudra and then a barber.

sa: गदया राक्षसो घोरो निजघान ननाद च। तद् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य घोरं कर्म भयावहम्॥
en: The fearful Rakshasa broke it down with his own mace and then uttered a terrible roar. The beholding that fearful and awe-inspiring feat achieved by the prince.

sa: इमं चाप्यपरं भूय इतिहासं निबोध मे। पितुर्मम सकाशे यद् ब्राह्मणः प्राह धर्मवित्॥
en: Do you listen to another story, which I will once more relate to you. This (story) a virtuous regenerate person told in the presence of my father.

sa: प्रतिज्ञामात्मनो रक्षन् सत्यां कर्तु च भारत। कुरुष्वाद्यत्मनो गुप्ति कस्ते गोप्ता गते मयि॥
en: And, O Bharata, he endeavours to keep his vow inviolate and true. Would you be able to protect yourself? Who shall protect you when I am gone?

sa: ॥ स कर्णं त्वं समुत्सृज्य राक्षसेन्द्रमलायुधम्। जहि क्षिप्रं महाबाहो पश्चात् कर्णं वधिष्यसि॥
en: Therefore for a time leaving alone Karna, do you quickly slay Alayudha that foremost of the Rakshasas, O mighty armed one, after which you shall slay Karna.”

sa: तावर्जुनं चतुःषष्ट्यासप्तत्या च जनार्दनम्। शराणां च शतैरश्वानविध्येतां मुदान्वितौ॥
en: Filled with delight they pierced Arjuna with sixty-four, Janardana with seventy and the horses with a hundred shafts.

sa: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा तथा बाहुं च दक्षिणम्। अध्ययुर्धरणी तीक्ष्णा वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Those sharp arrows penetrating through Karna's armour and piercing his right arm, sank into the earth, like so many fierce snakes entering their holes on ant hills.

sa: भवतां बाहुवीर्यं हि समाश्रित्य मया युधि। पाण्डवेयाः : समाहूता युद्धं चेदं प्रवर्तितम्॥
en: Depending upon the strength of your arms this war had been entered into and the descendants of Pandu had also been summoned to the battle by me.

sa: अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तो मित्राणां मित्रवत्सल। त्रायस्व समरे कर्ण सर्वान् योधान् महारथान्॥
en: The time is now, O you that are devoted to your friends (to seek your assistance). O Karna, save in battle all my soldiers and car warriors.

sa: तानिषूनिषुभिः कर्णो वारयित्वा महामृधे। कवचं भीमसेनस्य पाट्यामास सायकैः॥
en: Checking those arrows with his own, in that battle, Karna cut down Bhima's arīnour with numerous arrows. course

sa: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलस्तेषामासीत् किरीटिना॥ तस्यैव नः श्रुतो यादृनिवातकवचैः सह।
en: Furious was their encounter with Kiritin. It resembled that between Arjuna and Nivata Kavachas, as we have heard.

sa: पार्थश्चचार संग्रामे मृत्युर्विग्रहवानिव। सकिरीटानि वक्त्राणि साङ्गदान् विपुलान् भुजान्॥१५
en: Pritha's son careered on the field like Death incarnate. Heads decked with diadems,, huge arms adorned with Angadas.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा विहितं मृत्यु लोकतत्त्वविचक्षणः। दिव्यान्यस्राण्यथोत्सृज्य रणे प्रायमुपाविशत्॥
en: Abandoned his celestial weapons and betook to the Praya Joga. Then grasping his hair with his left hand.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय कर्णो भारत दुर्मनाः। इषुभिश्छादयामास भीमसेनं परंतपः॥
en: Thereupon, O Bharata, highly dejected, Karna took up another bow and covered Bhima with arrows on all directions.

sa: स लब्वा शनकैःसंज्ञां ताश्च दृष्टा स्त्रियो नृप। उन्मत्त इव राजेन्द्र स्थितस्तूष्णीं विशाम्पते॥
en: O Lord of carth, having gradually attained to consciousness and understanding the rniserable plight of those ladies, the monarch, like at senseless being, remained silent for sometime.

sa: तंद्रोणोऽनुययौ क्रुद्धो विकिरन् विशिखान् बहून्॥ युयुधानं महाभागं गच्छन्तमनिवर्तिनम्।
en: Thereupon, inflamed with rage, Drona began to pursue the illustrious Yuyudhana who was proceeding steadily, discharging numerous arrows.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनः कृष्णौ नवभिनवभिः शरैः॥ अविध्यत रणे राजञ्छरैराशीविषोपमैः।
en: O king, thereafter king Duryodhana, pierced the two Krishnas, each with none shafts. Resembling snakes of virulent poison.

sa: कुरुयोधवरा राजस्तव पुत्रं परीप्सवः। धनंजयरथं शीघ्रं सर्वतः समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Many foremost of car-warriors among the Kuru, swiftly rushed towards Dhananjaya's car, desirous, Oking, of saving your son.

sa: नाकम्पत महाबाहुः स्ववार्यं समपाश्रितः॥ सायकांश्चैव विविधानश्वत्थाग्नि मुमोच ह।
en: (Yet) that mighty-armed one did not tremble; (but) resorting to his own prowess discharged at Ashvatthama numerous arrows.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज वासुदेवः प्रतापवान्। प्रेषयत् तुरगांस्तत्र यत्र द्रौणिर्व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Having said this, O king, the powerful son of Vasudeva drove the horses where Drona's son was staying

sa: अहं हि तुल्यः सर्वेषां भूतानां नात्र संशयः। अधार्मिकास्तु हन्तव्या इति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: I am, indeed, equally disposed towards all the creatures. There is no doubt about it. My fixed vow is that the unrighteous ones should ever be slaughtered.

sa: तस्मादेनं राक्षसं घोररूपं शक्त्या जहि त्वं दत्तया वासवेन। मा कौरवाः सर्व एवेन्द्रकल्पा रात्रियुद्धे कर्ण नेशुः सयोधाः॥
en: Therefore slay this dreadful Rakshasa now with that dart given to you by Vasava. O Karna, let not these great warriors, the Kouravas these royal combatants that resemble Indra himself be all exterminated in this nightfight.

sa: सोमदत्तः पुनः क्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा सात्यकिमाहवे। महता शरवर्षेणच्छादयामास भारत॥
en: Growing angry again at seeing Satyaki in battle, O Bharata, Somadatta covered him with mighty discharge of arrows.

sa: अरुणेन यथा सार्धं तमः सूर्यो व्यपोहतिः। तथा कर्णेन सहितो जहि पार्थं महाहवे॥
en: Even as the Sun, being attended by the Arjuna, disposes the darkness, so you, being united with Karna, slaughter the son of Pritha in this dreadful battle.

sa: भीमसेनमनादृत्य रणेऽयुध्यत सूतजः। योऽजयत् समरे कर्ण पुरंदर इवासुरम्॥
en: Encountered Bhimasena in battle, totally disregarding him. He that has conquered Karna in battle, like Purandara conquering Asuras.

sa: कर्णः पार्थान् सगोविन्दान् जेतुमुत्सहते रणे। न च कर्णसमं योधं लोके पश्यामि कञ्चन॥
en: Karna is capable of conquering the Parthas together with Govinds himself; no where in the worlds do I find a warrior who is a match for Karna.

sa: इत्येवं धर्मराजेन हरिरुक्तो महायशाः। अनुरूपमिदं वाक्यं प्रत्युवाच जनार्दनः॥
en: The great illustrious god Janardana reciprocated Yudhishthira the Dharmaraja in the following words as per his appreciation made.

sa: तयोः समागमो राजंश्चित्ररूपो बभूव ह। व्यपेतजलद व्योम्नि बुधभास्करयोरिव॥
en: O king, the clash between looked as marvellous as that between Mercury and Venus in the cloudless sky.

sa: नापि वैरं न सौहार्द मद्रकेण समाचरेत्॥ मद्रके संगतं नास्ति मद्रको हि सदामलः।
en: No one should inake friends with a Madraka or enter into hostilities with him. There is no feeling of friendship in him. The Madraka is always impure.

sa: अनुकर्षानुपासंगान् पताका विविधध्वजान्॥ रथिनां च महाशङ्खान् पाण्डुरांश्च प्रकीर्णकान्।
en: There are scattered Anukarsha, Upasanga, Pataka, different type flags and huge size white conch of the charioteer-riders (Rathis).

sa: रथिनो रथिभिः सार्धमश्वारोहाश्च सादिभिः। मातङ्गा वरमातङ्गैः पदाताश्च पदातिभिः॥
en: Car-warriors became engaged with carwarriors, cavalry soldiers with cavalry-soldiers, elephants with other excellent elephants and infantry with infantry.

sa: अहं हि तं त्रिंशता वज्रकल्पैः समार्दयं निमिषस्यान्तरेणा क्षणाच्छवावित्समरूपौ बभूव समादितो मद्विसृष्टैः पृषत्कैः॥
en: In a moment, however, I struck him with thirty thunder-bolt like arrows. Greatly wounded with the shafts discharged by me he ere long looked like a porcupine.

sa: ये भक्तास्त्वां हृषीकेश दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥ परं पुराणं पुरुषं पराणां परमं च यत्।
en: They that are your worshippers, O Hrishikesha (always) get rid of difficulties. Supreme and Ancient male being and the most exalted of the exalted as you are.

sa: सारथिस्तमपोवाह रथेन रथिनां वरम्। कुरुसैन्यं ततः सर्व भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: His charioteer however carried away that foremost of car-warriors. Then the Kuru army surrounded Bhimasena from all sides.

sa: इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा भीमसेनवचश्च तत्। धृष्टद्युम्नं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य रणे स विमनाऽभवत्॥
en: Having heard these words of the sages, as also the words of Bhimasena and also beholding Dhristadyumna stand before him in battle, Drona was dejected at heart.

sa: भीमसेनः कुरून् राजन् हस्त्यनीकं च सर्वशः। एवमेष क्षयो वृत्तः कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः। अपराह्ने गते सूर्ये कासतां विपुलं यश॥
en: Thus the great destruction had taken place of all the forces of both the Kuru and Pandavas. Both the parties were most desirous of gaining fame, when the sun had passed the other side of meridian.

sa: स्वयं वैरं महत् कृत्वा पञ्चालैः पाण्डवैः सह। एकं सात्यकिमासाद्य कथं भीतोऽसि संयुगे॥
en: Having yourself provoked inveterate enmity with the Panchalas and the Pandavas, why do you now fly, out of fear, obtaining Satyaki alone in battle for your opponent?

sa: यत् तद् वाक्यं द्वैतवने त्वयोक्तं कर्णं हन्तास्म्येकरथेन सत्यम्। त्यक्त्वा तं वै कथमद्यापयातः कर्णाद् भीतो भीमसेनं विहाय॥
en: You said to me, O Partha, in the Daita forest that you would kill Karna with no one on your car. Why have you then, afraid of Karna, come here avoiding him and leaving behind Bhima.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवानां महारथम्। विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैः सर्वपारशवैः शितैः॥
en: Secing the great car-warrior of the Pandavas advance, Drona pierced him with ten arrows made wholly of steel.

sa: कृष्णो हि मूलं पाण्डूनां पार्थः स्कन्ध इवोद्गतः। शाखा इवेतरे पार्थाः पञ्चालाः पत्रसंज्ञिताः॥
en: Krishna is the root of the Pandavas, Partha is their risen trunk. The other sons of Pritha and the Panchalas are like their branches and leaves respectively.

sa: कर्मणस्तस्य दुर्वृत्त फलं प्राप्नुहि संयुगे। अद्य च्छेत्स्यामि ते मूढ शिरो विक्रम्य पत्रिणा॥
en: 0 wicked one, suffer (now) the consequences of that act of yours in battle. Exerting my strength, O fool, I will today cutoff your head with arrows?

sa: कर्ण उवाच प्रकृतिस्थोऽसि मे शल्य इदानी सम्पतस्तथा। प्रतिभासि महाबाहो मा भैषीस्त्वं धनंजयात्॥
en: Karna said O strong-armed Shalya, you are no longer afraid of Dhananjaya and seen to be in good humour and as such you are agreeable to men.

sa: तं जयन्तमनीकानि भारद्वाजं ततस्ततः। पाञ्चालपुत्रो द्युतिमान् वीरकेतुः समभ्ययात्॥
en: Thereat the effulgent Viraketu, the Panchala prince, encountered Drona the of Bharadvaja who had been vanquishing his troops.

sa: केचिदभ्याहता नागैर्नागा नगनिभोपमाः। विनेशुः समरे तस्मिन् पत्रवन्त इवाद्रयः॥
en: Struck by their antagonists some of those creatures, huge as hills, fell down in battle like winged mountains.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कर्णदुर्योधनादीनां शकुनेः सौबलस्य च। अपनीतं महत् तात तव चैव विशेषतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O sire, this act of Karna, Duryodhana, Sakuni the son of Subala and especially of yourself, has been very much against the dictates of policy.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सोमदत्तो महारथः। सात्यकि छादयामास शरवृष्ट्या महाबलः॥
en: Thereupon the greatly puissant Somadatta, the great car-warrior, taking up another bow, covered Satyaki with downpours of shafts.

sa: हयाश्च निहता बाणैर्हेमभाण्डविभूषिताः। निषेदुश्चैव मम्लुश्च बभ्रमुश्च दिशो दश॥
en: Horses, adorned with golden trappings, kills by arrows, fell down or became weak or ran in all directions.

sa: कर्णो हि बलवान् दृप्तः कृतास्त्रश्च महारथः॥ कृती च चित्रयोधी च देशकालस्य कोविदः।
en: Karna is valiant, proud, an adept in the use of weapons, an expert charioteer, skilled in the tactics of war, a veteran warrior and an able diplomatist.

sa: मेदोमजावसामत्तास्तृप्त मांसस्य चैव ह। धावमानाः स्म दृश्यन्ते काकगृघ्रबकास्तथा॥
en: And gratified with fat, marrow and flesh crows, vultures and cranes were seen to move about in delight.

sa: शूरास्तु समरे राजन् भयं त्यक्त्वा सुदुस्त्यजम्। योघव्रतसमाख्याताश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत्॥
en: The heroes, however, O king, shaking off fear and observing the warrior's warrior's vow, fearlessly did their duty.

sa: नसंख्येयान् कालकेयांश्च सर्वान। लेभे शङ्ख देवदत्त स्म तत्र को नाम तेनाभ्यधिकः पृथिव्याम्॥
en: He, after destroying numberless Daityas and the Kalakeyas in the dominion of Indra, received the Devdatta conch; there is no mightier man than he in all world.

sa: सर्वानसम्भ्रमाद् राजन् प्रत्यविद्ध्यत् त्रिभित्रिभिः। द्रोणं द्रौणिं च कर्णं च विव्याध च तवात्मजम्॥
en: Dhristadyumna was then pierced by the seven heroes who strove to protect Drona in battle. He also in his turn, pierced each of them with three shafts.

sa: तोषितो भगवान् येन महात्मा वृषभध्वजः। कथं वा तस्य न जयो जायते शतलोचन॥
en: O you with hundred eyes, why will not he be victorious, who both pleased the noble and sacred God who has the bull marked on his banner.

sa: यदाभिमन्युनिहतो धार्तराष्टैर्दुरात्मभिः। नासीत् तत्र रणे कृष्ण सव्यसाची महारथः॥
en: O Krishna, when Abhimanyu was slain by the sinful Dhartarashtras the mighty carwarrior Savyasachin was not at hand.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन वैकर्तनमजिह्मगैः॥ छादयामास पार्थोऽथ कर्णस्तु विजयं शरैः।
en: Partha then enveloped Karna who was thus furiously advancing against him, with straightcoursing arrows furnished with golden wings.

sa: पादबन्धं ततश्चक्रे पाण्डवः परवीरहा। नागमस्त्रं महाराज सम्प्रकीर्य मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: O monarch, then repeatedly invoking the Naga weapon, Paridava, the slayers of hostile horses, tied down their legs.

sa: ततो द्वात्रिंशता भल्लैर्निशितैस्तिग्मतेजनैः। विव्याध समरे कर्ण भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then the highly puissant Bhimasena pierced Karna in that battle, with thirty-two Vallas of great sharpness and energy.

sa: ततः कुरुषु भग्नेषु बीभत्सुरपराजितः॥ भीमसेन समासाद्य मुहूर्तं सोऽभ्यवर्तत।
en: Thus breaking down the Kuru army the unconquerable Vibhatsu then approached Bhimasena and resied there for a while.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु राजानं धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। संशप्तकगणान् क्रुद्धो ह्यभ्यधावद् धनंजयः॥
en: Duryodhana, too, proceeded against the king Yudhishthira the son of Dhrama, while Dhananjaya rushed against the wrathful Samsaptakas.

sa: संजय उवाच द्रौणियुधिष्ठिरं दृष्ट्वा शैनेयेनाभिरक्षितम्। द्रौपदेयैस्तथा शूरैरभ्यवर्तत हृष्टवतः॥ किरन्निषुगणान् घोरान् स्वर्णपुङ्खाशिलाशितान्। दर्शयन् विविधान् मार्गान् शिक्षाश्च लघुहस्तवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding Yudhishthira protected by Sini's son as well as by the war-like sons of Draupadi, the son of Drona, as if delighted, proceeded against him, scattering goldfeathered arrows, showing various ways of his light-handedness.

sa: अभिद्रवन्तु संहष्टाः कुम्भयोनि समन्ततः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च द्रौपदेयाः प्रभद्रकाः॥
en: Wrathfully assail thc pot-born Drona from all sides. Nakula and Sahadeva, the son of Draupadi and the Pravadrakas.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे संग्रामेऽद्भुतदर्शने॥ निहंत्य पृतनामध्ये संशप्तकगणान् बहून्। अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो वासुदेवमताब्रवीत्॥
en: In that extremely fierce and awe-inspiring battle, Arjuna, that foremost of victorious heroes, having killed a large number of Samasaptakas in the very heart of their array,

sa: ततोऽपायानृपस्तत्र भीमसेनस्य गोचरात्॥ कुरुसैन्यं ततः सर्व भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत्। तत्र नादो महानासीद् भीमसेन जिघांसताम्॥
en: The king soon fled away from Bhimasena's view. Then the entire Kuru army rushed towards Bhimasena. And desirous of killing Bhima they set up a terrible shout.

sa: यस्मात् तु बहु रूक्षं च श्रावितस्ते वृकोदरः। परोक्षं यच सौभद्रो युष्माभिनिहतो मम॥
en: As you have indulged in many harsh words against Vrikodara and as you have jointly with others, killed the son of Subhadra, when I was not present.

sa: अक्षयं क्षपयेत् कश्चित् क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियर्षभम्। तं न वित्तपतिर्नेन्द्रो न यमो न जलेश्वरः॥
en: When furnished with weapons, neither the Lord of wealth, nor Indra nor Yama, nor Varuna, nor the Asuras nor the Rakshasas, will be able to defeat him?

sa: ललाटस्थं ततो बाणं धारयामासं पाण्डवः। यथा शृङ्गं वने दृप्तः खङ्गो धारयते नृप॥
en: Thereafter, O king, the son of (Pandu), carried the shafts, that was struck in his forehead; even as the proud rhinoceros in the forest bears his horn.

sa: स पार्थबाणैर्विनिपातितायुधो ध्वजावमः च कृते महाहवे। कृतः कृपो बाणसहस्रयन्त्रितो यथाऽऽपगेयः प्रथमं किरीटिना॥
en: As Kiritin had distressed Ganga's son Bhima before, so Kripa was now distressed in that great fight with innumerable shots after striking off his standard and weapons.

sa: यावदिच्छसि रत्नानि हिरण्यं वा द्विजोत्तम। तावद् ददामि ते सर्वं दीयतां शबला मम॥
en: And as much of gems and gold, O best of regenerate ones, as you will ask for, shall I bestow upon you: do you grant me Sabala.'

sa: सोऽवतीर्य रथाच्छीघ्रं राजवेश्म प्रविश्य च। कक्ष्याः सप्ताभिचक्राम महाजनसमाकुलाः॥
en: Swiftly alighting from the car and entering the royal residence, he went past seven apartments thronged with people.

sa: एवमुक्तो नरव्याघ्रः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। ऋषिणा शरभङ्गेन राघवो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
en: Thus addressed by the sage, Sarabhanga, that best of men, Rāghava, versed in every branch of learning, said.

sa: क्षत्रबन्धो स्थितोऽस्म्येष यद् बलं तद् विदर्शय। नाशयाम्यद्य ते दर्प शस्त्रस्य तव गाधिजः॥
en: Wretch of a Kșatriya! here am I, do you display the might you are master of. To-day, O Gādhi's son, will I humble your pride of arms.

sa: भयं कच्चिन्न चास्मासु कुतश्चिद् विद्यते महत्। कुतो निमित्तः शोकस्ते ब्रूहि सर्वहितैषिणि ॥
en: Is there any great danger in any quarter? Do you, O you that are intent on the welfare of all, say, whence is this grief of yours?

sa: सरांसि सरितो वापीः काननानि वनानि च। तां विना मृगशावाक्षीं चरनाद्य सुखं लभे॥
en: Without her having the eyes of a fawn, I do not attain to felicity to-day, ranging at large by ponds, streams, pools and in forests and woods.

sa: इत्युक्त्वानृपशार्दूलः सचिवान् समुपस्थितान्॥ विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महामतिः।
en: Having said this, that mighty-minded tiger among nen dismissed his ministers, and himself entered into the inner apartment.

sa: प्रत्याख्याय हि मां भीरु पश्चात्तापं गमिष्यसि। चरणेनाभिहत्येव पुरुरवसमुर्वशी॥
en: O timid damsel, truly shall you repent afterwards if you did disregard me, like to Urvasi kicking Pururavā.

sa: ततः प्रियं वाक्यमुपेत्य राक्षसा महार्थमष्टावभिवाद्य रावणम्। विहाय लङ्कां सहिताः प्रतस्थिरे यतो जनस्थानमलक्ष्यदर्शनाः॥
en: Hearing these agreeable and weighty words of Ravana, those Raksasas, bowing down to Rāvana, left Lankā, and in a body invisible proceeded in the direction of Janasthāna.

sa: अदूराच्चित्रकूटस्य ददर्श भरतस्तदा। आश्रमं यत्र स मुनिर्भरद्वाजः कृतालयः॥
en: At a short distance from Citrakuța, Bharata beheld the spot where the ascetic Bharadvāja had built his habitation.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा मैथिली वाक्यं प्रियाहाँ प्रियवादिनीम्॥ अभिगम्य सुदृष्टात्मा राक्षसः काममोहितः। जग्राह रावणः सीतां बुधः खे रोहिणीमिव ॥
en: Speaking thus to Maithili, sweet-speeched and worthy of being sweetly addressed, that highly wicked Raksasa, Rāvaņa, being exercised with lust, approached towards Sītā and got hold of her, like to Budha holding Rohinī in the sky.

sa: तं मातरो बाष्पगृहीतकण्ठ्यो दुःखेन नामन्त्रयितुं हि शेकुः। स चैव मातृरभिवाद्य सर्वा रुदन् कुटी स्वां प्रविवेश रामः॥
en: His mothers with their throats invaded by the vapour of grief could not from distress of heart say ought to him. And Rāma also having paid homage to all of them, weeping entered his own cottage.

sa: दीर्घायुषो नराः सर्वे धर्म सत्यं च संश्रिताः। सहिताः पुत्रपौत्रैश्च नित्यं स्त्रीभिः पुरोत्तमे॥
en: And the men were long-lived; and ever abode by duty and truth; and lived in that best of cities, always surrounded by sons and grandsons and wives.

sa: ततः सुमन्त्रः काकुत्स्थं प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। विनीतो विनयज्ञश्च मातलिसिवं यथा॥
en: Then like to Mātali addressing Väsava, that one understanding humility, Sumantra, with joined hands humbly said to Kākutstha.

sa: भरताय महाराजो यौवराज्यं प्रयच्छति। मां पुनर्दण्डकारण्यं विवासयति तापसम्॥
en: The king shall confer upon Bharata the heirapparentship and shall banish me as an ascetic into the forest.

sa: ततः परमसम्भ्रान्ताः सर्षिसङ्घाः सुरासुराः। विश्वामित्रं महात्मानमूचुः सानुनयं वचः॥
en: Thereupon, in trepidation, the saints and the celestials and the Asuras humbly addressed the high souled Viśvāmitra thus.

sa: विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः प्रस्थितान् वीक्ष्य तानृषीन्। अब्रवीत्ररशार्दूल सर्वांस्तान् वनवासिनः॥
en: And, O puissant one, seeing those saints gone, the highly energetic Viśvāmitra addressed those inhabitants of the forest.

sa: नान्यो दोषो भवेदत्र मृगेभ्योऽन्यत्र विद्धि वै। तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य महर्षेर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः॥ उवाच वचनं धीरो विगृह्य सशरं धनुः।
en: Save what comes, from these deer, there is no other evil to be encountered here. Hearing those words of the Maharși, the placid elder brother of Lakşınaņa, taking up his bow with the arrow set, said

sa: इति ब्रुवाणो दृढसत्यविक्रमो महायशा दाशरथिः प्रतापवान्। अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिमुदग्रविक्रमः स्थिरां तदा स्वां मतिमात्मनाऽकरोत्॥
en: Addressing these words to Saumitrī, the resolute, powerful and highly famous son of Dasaratha, having truth for his prowess, composed himself by dint of his own understanding.

sa: तिष्ठतः किं नु मां दृष्ट्वा क्षुधार्तं क्षत्रियर्षभौ। आहारार्थं तु संदिष्टौ दैवेन हतचेतनौ॥
en: O two best of Ksatryas, are you waiting here beholding me hungry? O you having lost your sense, you have been chosen by Destiny as my food.

sa: पूर्वोऽयं वार्षिको मासः श्रावणः सलिलागमः। प्रवृत्ताः सौम्य चत्वारो मासा वार्षिकसंज्ञिताः॥ नायमुद्योगसमयः प्रविश त्वं पुरीं शुभाम्। अस्मिन् वत्स्याम्यहं सौम्य पर्वते सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: O gentle one, this month of Sravana, which is the first of those four months which make up the rainy season, has set in and this is not the time therefore enter your auspicious city and I shall live in this mountain along with Lakṣmaṇa.

sa: कामस्वभावोयः सोऽसौ न शक्यस्तं प्रमार्जितुम्। नहि दुष्टात्मनामार्यमावसत्यालये जिरम्॥
en: A vicious person can never relinquish his sinful habits—virtue does never reside in the abodes of impious persons.

sa: यत् तु मे हृद्गतं वाक्यं तस्य कार्यस्य निश्चयम्। कुरुष्व राजशार्दूल भव सत्यव्रतिश्रवः॥
en: Do you, O tiger of a king, ascertain your course in respect of the matter I bear in my heart; and do you prove firm in promise!

sa: विभीषणाभिषेकं च पुष्पकस्य च दर्शनम्। अयोध्यायाश्च गमनं भरद्वाजसमागमम्॥
en: And the coronation of Vibhīşaņa, and the sight of Puspaka; Rama's return towards Ayodhyā, and meeting with Bharadvāja.

sa: तत्र लोध्रवनं रम्यं सप्तपर्णवनानि च। विचिन्वन्तो हरिवराः सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: And eager to behold Sītā, those excellent monkeys began to search the Lodhra wood, and the Saptaparņa forests.

sa: कालधर्म गते राम सगरे प्रकृतीजनाः। राजानं रोचयामासुरंशुमन्तं सुधार्मिकम्॥
en: When Sagara had bowed to the influence of Time, the subjects selected the righteous Ansumat for their king.

sa: अम्बरीषस्तु राजर्षी रथमारोप्य सत्वरः। शुनःशेपं महातेजा जगामाशु महापशाः॥
en: That royal saint, the exceedingly energetic and highly famous Ambarīşa, placing Sunaḥsepa on his car, speedily set out.

sa: तीक्ष्णमल्पप्रदातारं प्रमत्तं गर्वितं शठम्। व्यसने सर्वभूतानि नाभिधावन्ति पार्थिवम्॥
en: People do not in times of peril assist a sovereign that is wrathful, stingy, intoxicated, haughty and deceitful.

sa: ततस्तु विगते वाष्पे सूतं स्पृष्टोदकं शुचिम्। रामस्तु मधुरं वाक्यं पुनः पुनरुवाच तम्॥
en: Then when he had dried up his tears, and sanctified himself by touching the water of the Gangā, Rāma again addressed the charioteer in sweet words, saying.

sa: इक्ष्वाकोस्तु सुतः श्रीमान् कुक्षिरित्येव विश्रुतः। कुक्षेरथात्मजः श्रीमान् विकुक्षिरुदपद्यत॥
en: And Ikşvāku's son, it is well known, was the graceful Kuksi. And Kuksi's son was the graceful Vikuksi.

sa: एवमुक्तः कबन्धस्तु लक्ष्मणेनोत्तरं वचः। उवाच वचनं प्रीतस्तदिन्द्रवचनं स्मरन्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Lakṣmaṇa with these goodly words, Kabandha, pleased, recollecting the words of Indra, bespoke him,

sa: त्वया नाथेन काकुत्स्थ न सनाथा वसुंधरा। प्रमदा शीलसम्पूर्णा पत्येव च विधर्मणा ।॥
en: O Kākutstha, the Earth has got you as her husband like to a good natured damsel being wedded to a husband who has forsaken his own religion.

sa: नित्यं शुचिमतिः सौम्य चर धर्मं तपोवने। सर्वं तु विदितं तुभ्यं त्रैलोक्यमपि तत्त्वतः॥
en: O mild one! ever cherishing your heart in purity, do you practise piety in the wood of asceticism Everything the three worlds are truly known to you.

sa: आरोग्य शिबिकां चैव वालिनं गतजीवितम्। अलंकारैश्च विविधैर्माल्यैर्वस्त्रैश्च भूषितम्॥
en: And placing the lifeless body of Vāli on it, he covered it with various ornaments, garlands, and clothes.

sa: तासामेवंविधा वाचः शृण्वन् दशरथात्मजः। बबन्धैव तथा चीरं सीतया तुल्यशीलया॥ चीरे गृहीते तु तया सबाष्पो नृपतेर्गुरुः। निवार्य सीतां कैकेयीं वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these words, Dasaratha's son tied the dress on Sītā having a similar character with himself. When she had put on the upper and under garments, the preceptor of the king, Vasiştha, his voice choked with the vapour of sorrow, dissuading Sita, said to Kaikeyi.

sa: पादमूलं गमिष्यामि तस्यैवाहं महात्मनः। योऽसौ रामप्रयुक्तेन शरेण विनिपातितः॥
en: I shall place myself at the feet of that highsouled one, who has been killed by Rama's shaft.

sa: क्रमेण गत्वा प्रविलोकयन् वनं ददर्श पम्पां शुभदर्शकाननाम्। अनेकनानाविधपक्षिसंकुलं विवेश रामः सह लक्ष्मणेन॥
en: Proceeding slowly, observing the forest, Rāma beheld and entered with Lakşmaņa Pampā, girt on all sides with beautiful woods and filled with a multitude of diverse birds.

sa: अस्त्रं हयशिरो नाम क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च॥ शक्तिद्वयं च काकुत्स्थ ददामि तव राघव।
en: O sinless one! And, O Rāghava, I will confer are upon you the weapon called Hayasiras, and the Krauñca weapon, and, O Kākutstha, a couple of darts.

sa: बुद्धिः प्रणीता येनेयं मनश्च सुसमाहितम्। तं नु नार्हामि संक्लेष्टुं प्रव्रजिष्यामि मा चिरम्॥
en: That great One, who' has inspired Kaikeyi with this mode of mind and has kept it firm, I cannot offend. I shall repair hence without any delay.

sa: तस्य व्यायच्छमानस्य रामस्यार्थे स रावणः। पक्षौ पादौ च पाश्वौं च खङ्गमुद्धृत्य सोऽच्छिनत्।।४२
en: Jațāyu addressing himself to displaying his prowess for the benefit of Rāma, Rāvaņa taking out his dagger, cut off his two wings, two legs and two sides.

sa: ततः कार्यसमासङ्गमवगम्य हनूमति। विदित्वा हनुमन्तं च चिन्तयामास राघवः॥
en: Thereat, understanding that success in the task depended upon Hanumān, and also knowing what Hanumān was, Rāghava reflected,

sa: इति पृष्ठस्तु भरतं भ्रातुर्दर्शनलालसम्। प्रत्युवाच महातेजा भरद्वाजो महातपाः॥
en: When Bharata eager to see his brother had asked thus, the highly energetic Bharadvāja of rigid austerities answered.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः। अशक्नुवन् धारयितुं कोपं संतापमात्मनः॥
en: Thus said that exceedingly energetic and mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, unable to contain his anger and indignation of heart.

sa: राज्यभ्रष्टेन दीनेन तापसेन पदातिना। सिं करिष्यसि रामेण मानुषिणाल्पतेजसा॥
en: What will you do with Rāma a human being of short life, poor, of small prowess, practising mendicancy?

sa: आजगाम ततो ब्रह्मा लोककर्ता स्वयं प्रभुः। चतुर्मुखो महातेजा द्रष्टुं तं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ॥
en: It came to pass that desirous of seeing the best of sages, there arrived, that lord and creator of all, the effulgent Brahmā, furnished with four countenances.

sa: एते हि समुपासीना विहगा जलचारिणः। नावगाहन्ति सलिलमप्रगल्भा इवाहवम्॥
en: And those aquatic fowls seated by, do not dip themselves in the water, like to cravens shunning fight.

sa: तेन शब्देन महता प्रत्युबुध्यत वानरः। मदविह्वलताम्राक्षो व्याकुलः स्रग्विभूषणः॥
en: By that terrible sound awoke that monkeychief, having coppery eyes, agitated, adorned with garlands and possessed by liquor.

sa: तद् वाक्यं जनकेनोक्तं श्रुत्वा दशरथस्तदा। प्रवेशयामास सुतान् सर्वानृषिगणानपि॥
en: Hearing those words uttered by Janaka, Dasaratha entered in together with his sons and the body of saints.

sa: तत्रापि निवसन्तौ तौ तlमाणौ च कामतः। भ्रातरौ स्मरतां वीरौ वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम्॥
en: Albeit thus staying, with every ministration extended towards them as much as they could wish, yet those heroic brothers failed not to remember the aged king Daſaratha.

sa: सुग्रीवेण समाख्याताः सर्वे वानरयूथपाः। तत्र देशान् विचिन्वन्ति सशैलवनकाननान्॥
en: And the leaders of monkey-herds search all those countries, countries, described described by Sugrīva,-containing mountains, woods and forests.

sa: कृतकामो महीं सर्वां चचार तपसि स्थितः। एवं त्वनेन ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्तं राम महात्मना॥
en: And, having secured his end, began to range the entire world, staying in asceticism. In this wise, O Rāma, was Brāhmanya actually obtained by the high-souled one.

sa: अस्मिन्नरण्ये भगवन्नगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः॥ वसतीति मया नित्यं कथाः कथयतां श्रुतम्। न तु जानामि तं देशं वनस्यास्य महत्तया॥
en: I have always heard from men speaking on the subject that that foremost of ascetics, the reverend Agastya, lives in this forest. On account of the vastness of this forest, I do not know that place.

sa: रामोऽभियाय तं रम्यं वृक्षमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। रथादवतरत् तस्मात् सभार्यः सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: And reaching the tree, that descendant of Ikşvāku alighted from the car along with his wife and Lakşmaņa.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं सैन्यमविषह्यं महाबलम्। हतमेकेन रामेण दूषणस्त्रिशिरा अपि॥ तबलं हतभूयिष्ठं विमनाः प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसः। आससाद खरो रामं नमुचिर्वासवं यथा ॥
en: Seeing that irresistible Raksasa host-even Düşaņa and Triſirā-slain by the mighty Rāma alone, and seeing the great courage that was made in the army, that Raksasa, Khara, was seized with despondency. Then as Namuci advances against Väsava, Khara stretching his powerful bow, advanced against Răma.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठं वैदेहो मिथिलाधिपः। प्रदक्षिणां चकाराशु सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः॥
en: Thus accosted, Mithila's lord, Vaideha, in company with his priests and friends, went round that foremost of ascetics,

sa: एतदस्यासमं वीर्यं मया राम प्रकाशितम्। कथं तं वालिनं हन्तुं समरे शक्ष्यसे नृप॥
en: I have related to you, O Rāma, the incomparable prowess of his. Do you tell me now, O hero, how canst you destroy him in the conflict?

sa: पिप्पलीनां च पक्वानां वनादम्मादुपागतः। गन्धोऽयं पवनोत्क्षिप्तः सहसा कटुकोदयः॥
en: And coming from the wood this scent is wafted by the wind the pungent odour of ripe Pippalis.

sa: अलं वीर व्यथां गत्वा न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि। शोचते ह्यवसीदन्ति सर्वार्था विदितं हिते॥
en: It does not behove you to lament thus, being exercised with grief—it is not unknown to you that people, thus bewailing do exhaust themselves by and by.

sa: यावदेव तु संसुप्तास्तावदेव वयं लघु। रथमारुह्य गच्छामः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्॥
en: Let us while they are asleep ascending on our car, swiftly go our way without fear of molestation.

sa: त्वयापि खलु तत् कार्यं तयोश्च नृपपुत्रयोः। ब्राह्मणानां गुरूणां च मुनीनां वासवस्य च॥
en: Even you shall do that act in behalf of those sons of the king, of the Brāhmanas, of the spiritual preceptors, of the ascetics, and of Vasava.

sa: मया च यदिदं वाक्यमभिमानाद् समीरितम्। तत्त्वया हरिशार्दूल तत्त्वमित्युपधार्यताम्॥
en: O best of monkeys, do you verily consider as true the words that I have uttered through affection.

sa: एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभी राजपुत्रैर्महात्मभिः। अधर्मसहिता नार्यो हताः पुरुषसत्तमैः। तस्मादेनां घृणां त्यक्त्वा जहि मच्छासनानृप॥
en: By these as well as innumerable princesforemost of men have wicked women been slain. Therefore, O king, renouncing antipathy, do you, by my command, slay this one!

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि तैरेवं कामरूपिभिः। विनाशितानि संहत्य नित्यशः पिशिताशनैः॥
en: In this way, thousands of Brāhmaṇas gathered together, were destroyed by flesh eating ones wearing shapes at will.

sa: स लक्ष्मणं शोकवशाभिपन्न शोके निमग्नो विपुले तु रामः। मुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य रुदन् सशोकम्॥
en: Sunk in the abyss of grief, Rāma, sighing hot and weeping piteously, spoke to Laksmana who was equally aggrieved, words worthy of being said on that occasion.

sa: तत्र गात्रं हतं तस्य निर्दग्धस्य महात्मनः। अशरीरः कृतः कामः क्रोधाद् देवेश्वरेण ह॥
en: And on his body being consumed by that high-souled one, Kāma was deprived of his person in consequence of the ire of that foremost among the deities.

sa: मधुरं सान्त्वितस्तेन सुग्रीवेण स राघवः। मुखमश्रुपरिक्लिन्नं वस्त्रान्तेन प्रमार्जयत्॥
en: Thus sweetly consoled by Sugrīva, Rāghava with the end of his cloth wiped his face tarnished with tears.

sa: एवमुक्ता महाभागैस्तदाहं पुरुषर्षभ। मया तु संचितं वन्यं विविधं पुरुषर्षभ॥ तवार्थे पुरुषव्याघ्र पम्पायास्तीरसम्भवम्।
en: O best of men, I was thus told by those great ascetics, and for you I have collected various wild fruits growing on the banks of Pampā.

sa: एवमुक्तो हनुमता राघवः परवीरहा॥ प्रत्युवाच हनूमन्तं बुद्धिमान् वाक्यकोविदः।
en: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, the highly intelligent Rāghava, skilled in speech and the slayer of foes, replied;

sa: ततः किलकिलां चक्कुर्लक्ष्मणं प्रेक्ष्य वानराः। प्रसादयन्तस्तं क्रुद्धं भयमोहितचेतसः॥
en: Beholding Lakşmaņa highly enraged, the monkeys, possessed by fear, began to make noise as they were welcoming him.

sa: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तदानम्य महाबलः। ज्यां समारोप्य झटिति पूरयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: Thereupon, in the twinkling of an eye, bending it, the powerful (Raghava) stringed the bow and drew it.

sa: तरुणी रूपसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना॥
en: I have seen a youthful and beautiful female, adorned with all ornaments, carried away by the wicked Rāvana,

sa: अपि शान्तेन मनसा गुरुर्मे कुशिकात्मज। इहागतेन रामेण पूजितेनाभिवादितः॥
en: And, O Kusika's son, was my revered sire of quiescent soul, saluted by Rāma when he arrived there?

sa: दिष्ट्या न चलितो धर्मादात्मा ते सहलक्षणः। वत्स सत्यप्रतिज्ञो हि सतां लोकानवाप्स्यसि ॥ इत्युक्त्वा चाङ्कमानीय भरतं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। परिष्वज्य महाबाहुं रुरोद भृशदुःखिता॥
en: Lucky it is that graced with auspicious marks, you swerves not from virtue. My child, for this reason you will attain the regions of pious person, drawing into her lap Bharata attached to his brother, and embracing the mighty armed one, gave way to grief.

sa: क्वचिन्नीलोत्पलैश्छन्ना भाति रक्तोत्पलैः क्वचित्। क्वचिदाभाति शुक्लैश्च दिव्यैः कुमुदकुड्मलैः॥
en: Here it appears covered with violet lotuses, here with red lotuses and there again with celestial white water-lilies.

sa: अवष्टभ्यावतिष्ठन्तं ददर्श धनुरूर्जितम्। रामं रामानुजं चैव भर्तुश्चैव तथानुजम्॥
en: She espied Rāma reclining his person on a mighty bow, his younger brother and her husband's younger brother.

sa: सा त्वेवमुक्ता धर्मज्ञा तया प्रीततराऽभवत्। सफलं च प्रहर्षं ते हन्त सीते करोम्यहम्॥
en: Thus accosted, that one cognizant of virtue, was still more pleased, and said, “I am exceedingly pleased (with your words). I will attain a desire of mine."

sa: विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा कथान्ते रघुनन्दनः। उवाच परमप्रीतो मुनि दीप्तमिवानलम्॥
en: When Viśvāmitra had ended, hearing his words, Rāma exceedingly pleased, spoke to that ascetic resembling flaming fire, saying,

sa: नियमैर्विविधैराप्तं तपो हि महदस्ति मे। तत् संश्रित्य बलं सीते छन्दये त्वां शुचिव्रते॥
en: By observing restrictions, I have earned great asceticism. By resorting to that energy, I would, O Sīta, confer a boon upon you, O you of pure vows.

sa: न्यासभूतासि वैदेहि न्यस्ता मयि महात्मना ॥ रामेण त्वं वरारोहे न त्वां त्यक्तुमिहोत्सहे।
en: O Vaidehī, you have been left to my charge by the high-souled (Rama)-I therefore do not dare leave you behind, O you the jewel of a damsel.

sa: अन्ननिस्यन्दजातानि मूलानि च फलानि च। अमृतस्वादुकल्पानि ददृशुस्तत्र वानराः॥
en: There the monkeys found grateful fruits and roots sprung from the streams of sacrificial oblations, and resembling ambrosia.

sa: तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत्। युद्धे प्राणहरे तस्मिन्निष्पिष्टो दुन्दुभिस्तदा॥
en: Holding up Dundubhi he threw him on the ground. And in that dreadful skirmish Dundhubhi was greatly reduced.

sa: तस्माच्च यज्ञायतनात् पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च। आनिन्युनिरा गत्वा सुग्रीवप्रियकारणात्॥
en: And for compassing the good of Sugrīva, repairing thither, the monkeys brought ordorous blossoms from the sacrificial ground.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भग्नः सुग्रीवस्तेन वालिना। अपश्यन् राघवं नाथमृष्यमूकं प्रदुद्रुवे॥
en: In the mean time, being defeated by Vāli, Sugrīva fled away and not beholding Rāghava, proceeded towards Rșyamuka.

sa: एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ पूर्वमास्तां नरोत्तम॥ मलदाश्च करूषाश्च देवनिर्माणनिर्मितौ।
en: Here were formerly, O foremost of men, two flourishing provinces, named Malada, and Karāsa, built by celestial architects.
